The Written Test is a Professional Knowledge - Subjective paper. There is no negative marking. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including time for verification and completion of various formalities. Candidates reporting late after the reporting time specified on the call letter will not be permitted to take the examination.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted from the Written Test will be called for Personal Interview to be conducted in Mumbai and/or New Delhi. Candidates must carry original and photocopy of valid photo identity proof along with the Interview Call Letter. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and final selection shall be final and binding.

Competition Level Analysis for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Exim Bank MT Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very intense given that only 05 vacancies are on offer across two disciplines from a large pool of MBA/PGDBM graduates across India. The Bank being a premier financial institution under the Government of India makes this an exceptionally sought-after position among finance, HR, and administration postgraduates. The subjective Written Test format — unlike the MCQ-based bank exams — demands strong subject knowledge, analytical writing ability, and command over HR / Administration concepts rather than just speed and aptitude.

The low vacancy count means even marginal differences in written test scores will determine shortlisting for the interview round. Candidates with domain depth in HRM/Personnel Management (for MT-HRM) or Hotel/Facilities/Civil background with MBA (for MT-Administration) are better positioned. The Personal Interview carrying 30% of the final weightage means soft skills, subject clarity, and awareness of Exim Bank's functions and India's international trade ecosystem will be critical differentiators at the final stage.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who have completed their graduation or postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning; they are categorically not eligible.
  • Candidates who do not hold a Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in the relevant specialization with minimum 60% marks in both graduation and post graduation.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21-28 years as on 30-04-2026 (except as per OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer; they must apply as General candidates. OBC certificate must be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date).
  • Candidates who have defaulted in any loan repayment and/or whose name appears in CIBIL database as a defaulter.
  • Candidates unwilling to serve anywhere in India or unwilling to be transferred to offices outside India (with consent).
  • Candidates unwilling to execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for 1 year as MT and minimum 5 years as employee after absorption.
  • Currently serving employees of Government / PSU who cannot produce a proper Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.
  • Candidates whose CGPA-based qualification does not include an equivalent percentage conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for MT-HRM without specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management, or applying for MT-Administration without the prescribed qualification combinations.
  • Not checking whether your graduation and postgraduation are from a full-time regular programme; part-time/distance mode graduates are not eligible even if the university is recognized.
  • Entering less than 60% marks in either graduation or postgraduation; both must independently meet the 60% threshold.
  • OBC candidates applying with an expired caste certificate; OBC NCL certificate must be issued within one year prior to the last date of applying and must contain the non-creamy layer clause.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration; any mismatch or unclear document can lead to rejection.
  • Writing the handwritten declaration in capital letters or in a language other than English; both will render the application invalid.
  • Using an inactive or incorrect mobile number/email ID, causing missed notifications for call letters, exam updates, or interview communication.
  • Pressing the BACK or REFRESH button during the online payment process, which may result in double charge or payment failure.

  • Submitting application without verifying that the name as filled in the form exactly matches the name on photo identity proof; any mismatch will lead to disqualification at the exam/interview stage.

NHSRCL DE & JE Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

For the Deputy Engineer grade (Vacancy Nos. 21–25/2026), selection consists of four stages in this order: Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, Interview, and Medical Examination.

For the Junior Engineer grade (Vacancy Nos. 26–32/2026), selection consists of three stages: Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, and Medical Examination. Note that the Interview stage is not part of the JE-grade selection process.

In both cases, management reserves the right to include or dispense with any stage of the selection methodology. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through their registered email addresses. Out-station candidates called for interview (DE grade) will be paid Travelling Allowance as per company rules.

Medical fitness is a mandatory condition of appointment. Candidates will be examined as per the Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM). Additional medical tests such as Audiometry and Perimetry may also be conducted as required for safe operation of High Speed Trains.

Surety Bond and Service Commitment

Candidates selected for absorption must be aware of the following binding commitments before joining NHSRCL.

Surety Bond on Joining: Selected candidates must execute a surety bond of ₹3,00,000/- committing to serve NHSRCL for a minimum period of 4 years (excluding any period on Leave Without Pay or Extra-Ordinary Leave). A prior notice of 90 days is required before resigning from the corporation.

Surety Bond on Training: If training is provided, candidates must execute a separate surety bond for the cost of training plus applicable service tax, committing to serve for a minimum of 6 years after training completion. A three-month prior notice is required before resignation in such cases.

Candidates appointed on absorption basis will be on probation for one year. They may be posted anywhere across NHSRCL offices and the MAHSR Project.

Important Note on Controller and Safety Assignment

Candidates applying for posts that include a Controller or Safety assignment (such as Vacancy Nos. 21–29, 31/2026) must indicate their willingness for such assignments in the online application form. They must also furnish their order of preference between the available designations at the time of application. However, the final allocation of post or assignment rests entirely at NHSRCL's discretion, regardless of the candidate's stated preference.

Document Requirements

Along with the application, candidates must submit a Competency Certificate or Experience Certificate issued by their employer. This certificate must clearly indicate the required work experience with year-wise details of the nature and type of work performed. Incomplete applications or applications submitted without supporting documents will be rejected outright.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Applying for NHSRCL absorption posts is a specialized process. Keep the following in mind to avoid rejection:

  • Do not apply for more than one post within the same vacancy notice group (21–25 or 26–32). Only one application is permitted per group, and both CBT sessions may be held simultaneously.
  • Save your registration credentials immediately after creating your portal account. NHSRCL communicates exclusively through registered email IDs - check your spam folder regularly.
  • Verify eligibility before paying the fee. The ₹400 fee is non-refundable under all circumstances, including ineligibility or withdrawal.
  • If your internet connection drops during payment, do not immediately retry - check your bank statement first to avoid a double payment. Contact your bank if the amount is debited but confirmation is not received.
  • Use an updated browser on a stable connection for the application portal. Avoid submitting on the final day to prevent server congestion issues.
  • Ensure your experience certificate is on your employer's letterhead with year-wise work details - general appointment letters or offer letters alone are not acceptable.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Karnataka State Police (KSP) has officially released the KSP Recruitment 2026 notification, announcing 3,991 vacancies for the post of Civil Police Constable across two separate cadres. This is one of the biggest police recruitment drives in Karnataka in recent years, and online applications are now open on the KEA portal from 8th June 2026 to 3rd July 2026. The written examination is scheduled for 2nd August 2026.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

If you are a Karnataka resident who has passed Class 12 (PUC) and has been looking for a stable government job in law enforcement, this is your chance. Read on for a complete breakdown of the KSP Constable Recruitment 2026 - from eligibility and vacancies to how to apply and what to expect in the selection process.

Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Karnataka State Police, Central Recruitment & Promotion Department, Bengaluru has officially released two notifications - Advertisement No. 01/Recruitment-4/2026-27 (Kalyana Karnataka / 371(J) cadre) and Advertisement No. 02/Recruitment-4/2026-27 (Mikkili/Okkalida cadre) - both dated 05.06.2026, for direct recruitment of Police Constable (Civil) posts. The notifications include complete details on vacancies, eligibility, selection process, exam pattern, physical standards, age relaxations, reservation, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notifications before applying.

  • Download Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF - Kalyana Karnataka (596 Posts)
  • Download Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF - Mikkili/Okkalida Cadre (3395 Posts)

KSP Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before submitting your PC application for 2026 Karnataka, carefully verify that you meet all eligibility conditions. Candidates who do not meet the educational, age, or language criteria will be disqualified at any stage of the process.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed Class 12 / PUC or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. This includes:

  • Class 12 passed from CBSE, ICSE, any State Board, or equivalent
  • Class 12 equivalent from NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling)
  • A 2-year ITC/Diploma (NVBT) course with one language and one academic subject from NIOS
  • A 3-year Diploma from a recognised Polytechnic institution (treated as equivalent to PUC for direct/compassionate recruitment)

Kannada Language Requirement: Candidates must have studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC/10th standard. Those who have not done so must pass a Kannada Language Test conducted by KEA.

Age Limit

The minimum age for all candidates is 18 years. The upper age limit varies by category as follows:

Category Maximum Age
General - Male, Female & 3rd Gender (Direct) 33 years
SC / ST / Cat-1 / Cat-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B (Direct) 35 years
Budakattu (Forest Area) SC Candidates 38 years
Ex-Servicemen (General) 38 years
Ex-Servicemen (SC/ST/OBC) 40 years

Age is calculated as of the notification date. Candidates should refer to the official PDF for precise age cut-off dates.

KSP Constable Application Fee 2026

The application fee for the KSP Constable recruitment must be paid online only, and is non-refundable under all circumstances. Candidates must ensure payment is completed before 4th July 2026.

Category Application Fee
General / OBC (Cat-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B) Rs. 750/-
SC / ST / Cat-1 / Ex-Servicemen / 3rd Gender Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online for KSP Constable Recruitment 2026

The KSP Constable apply online 2026 process is conducted through the KEA (Karnataka Examinations Authority) portal. Follow these steps carefully to submit a valid application for Karnataka police constable recruitment 2026.

  • Step 1: Visit the official KEA recruitment portal at https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/
  • Step 2: Click on the active link for KSP Civil Police Constable Recruitment 2026 (Adv. No. 01 or 02, depending on which cadre you are eligible for).
  • Step 3: Register by entering your personal, educational, and category details accurately.
  • Step 4: Choose the cadre (Kalyana-Karnataka or General) you are applying for. Note: only one application per notification is permitted.
  • Step 5: Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPEG, 50KB-200KB) and your signature (JPEG, 50KB-70KB).
  • Step 6: Pay the required application fee online through the portal.
  • Step 7: Download and save a copy of the submitted application form and the fee payment receipt.
Caution: No edits or corrections are permitted after final submission. Double-check all entries before clicking submit.
 
Apply Link: https://ksp-recruitment.in/

KSP Constable Selection Process 2026

The Karnataka police constable selection process 2026 consists of four clearly defined stages. Candidates must qualify each stage to proceed to the next. There is no direct interview; merit is determined through the written exam and physical assessments.

Stage 1 - Written Examination (CBT / OMR-Based)

The written test is the first and most critical stage of the pc recruitment 2026 Karnataka. It determines the candidates who will move on to physical testing.

Detail Information
Mode OMR-based (Offline)
Total Questions 100
Total Marks 100
Duration 90 Minutes (1 hour 30 minutes)
Minimum Qualifying Marks 30 out of 100
Negative Marking Yes - 0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer

Exam Timings:

  • Notification 1 (KK Cadre): 2:30 PM - 4:00 PM on 2nd August 2026
  • Notification 2 (General Cadre): 10:30 AM - 12:00 PM on 2nd August 2026

Subjects Covered:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science
  • Geography
  • Indian History
  • Indian Constitution
  • Karnataka State Affairs
  • Mental Ability & Reasoning
  • Ethics

Stage 2 - Physical Standard Test (PST)

Candidates who qualify the written exam must appear for physical measurements. Below are the height and chest requirements:

Category Height Chest
Male / Ex-Servicemen Min. 168 cm Min. 86 cm (expanded); expansion min. 5 cm
Female / 3rd Gender Min. 157 cm Min. weight: 45 kg
Budakattu Male (Forest Areas) Min. 155 cm Min. 75 cm; 5 cm expansion
Budakattu Female (Forest Areas) Min. 150 cm -

Stage 3 - Physical Efficiency / Endurance Test (PET)

Candidates who pass the PST will then undergo the physical endurance test. All events must be completed within the prescribed standards.

Event Male / Ex-Servicemen Female / 3rd Gender
Run 1,600m in 6 min 30 sec 400m in 2 min
High Jump Min. 1.20 m (3 chances) Min. 0.90 m (3 chances)
Long Jump Min. 3.80 m (3 chances) Min. 2.50 m (3 chances)
Shot Put (Weight) 7.26 kg; min. 5.60 m (3 chances) 4 kg; min. 3.75 m (3 chances)

Stage 4 - Medical Examination

Shortlisted candidates (in a 1:2 ratio per vacancy) will undergo a comprehensive medical examination by a Medical Board. This includes vision testing, hearing assessment, and musculoskeletal evaluation to ensure candidates are physically fit for active police duty.

Stage 5 - Document Verification

Candidates who clear the medical examination must present original academic certificates, domicile proof, category certificates, and other relevant documents for final verification.

KSP Constable Exam Pattern 2026

This section gives a concise view of the pc exam date 2026 Karnataka and the structure of the written test, helping candidates plan their preparation effectively.

Subject Questions Marks Duration
General Knowledge, Science, Geography, History, Indian Constitution, State Affairs, Mental Ability, Ethics 100 100 90 Minutes

Key Points to Remember:

  • Each correct answer carries 1 mark
  • Each wrong answer results in a deduction of 0.25 marks
  • Unanswered questions carry no penalty
  • Minimum qualifying score is 30 marks

KSP Constable Salary 2026

One of the most attractive aspects of the KSP Recruitment 2026 is the government pay structure. Karnataka police constables are placed at Pay Level 7 under the 7th Pay Commission, with a monthly pay scale of Rs. 37,500 - Rs. 76,100. In addition to the base salary, candidates are eligible for:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Travel Allowance (TA)
  • National Pension Scheme (NPS) benefits
  • Other Karnataka Government allowances

Training and Probation:

  • Selected candidates undergo 9 months of basic police training at designated Police Training Schools in Karnataka.
  • Candidates are on probation for 2 years and 6 months after formal appointment.
  • Candidates who fail during training may be removed from service.

Preferred certifications: AWS Solutions Architect (Professional), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

Work experience: Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience in IT/BFSI, of which at least 4 years in cloud architecture, cloud engineering, or DevOps roles.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable. Payment must be made online only - cash, cheques, money orders, and postal stamps are not accepted. Bank transaction charges for the online payment gateway are borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee
SC / ST / PwBD ₹100 + applicable taxes + payment gateway charges
General, EWS & OBC ₹850 + applicable taxes + payment gateway charges

Once submitted, an application cannot be withdrawn, and the fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor held in reserve for any other examination.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The bank will use a multi-stage selection process for all posts. All three scales - SMGS IV, MMGS III, and MMGS II - follow the same procedure: Written Test → Short-listing → Personal Interview.

The written test, where conducted, will have the following structure:

Section Questions Maximum Marks Duration
English Language 20 20 15 minutes
General Awareness 20 20 30 minutes
Professional Knowledge 60 60 60 minutes
Total 100 100 105 minutes

The minimum qualifying score in each section is 40% for General and EWS candidates and 35% for Reserved Category candidates. However, only Professional Knowledge marks are used for drawing the merit/rank list and shortlisting candidates for the Personal Interview; marks in English Language and General Awareness are not included in the final merit calculation.

Candidates clearing the written test are called for a Personal Interview. The minimum qualifying score for the interview is 40% for Unreserved and EWS candidates and 35% for Reserved categories. Final selection is based on the combined marks from the written test and Personal Interview, in order of merit ranking. Where two candidates tie at the cut-off, they are ranked in descending order of age.

The Personal Interview will be conducted in New Delhi unless otherwise specified. Call letters will be sent by email only. Candidates must attend at their own cost.

The bank shortlists candidates based on experience and suitability at its own discretion - meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee an interview call.

Examination Centres

The bank has designated examination centres across India. Candidates may opt for a centre in their state, subject to availability. The bank reserves the right to allot a different centre or cancel/add centres. No request for a change of examination centre, date, or session will be entertained. Selected centres include: Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), Guwahati (Assam), Patna and Bhagalpur (Bihar), Chandigarh/Mohali, Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Delhi/Delhi-NCR, Panaji (Goa), Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar (Gujarat), Ambala (Haryana), Hamirpur (Himachal Pradesh), Jammu (J&K), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Ernakulam (Kerala), Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh), Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai/MMR (Maharashtra), Bhubaneswar (Odisha), Patiala (Punjab), Jaipur (Rajasthan), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Hyderabad (Telangana), Prayagraj, Lucknow and Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), Dehradun (Uttarakhand), and Asansol and Siliguri (West Bengal), among others.

Terms of Contract

This engagement is on a contractual basis, not a regular/permanent appointment. The initial period is three years, subject to annual performance review. Depending on need and performance, the bank may extend the contract on an annual basis for up to a maximum of two additional years at its discretion.

The bank may terminate the contract at any time without assigning any reason by giving one month's notice or paying one month's fixed component of compensation in lieu. Similarly, the appointee must give the bank one month's clear notice - or equivalent payment - to exit the contract before its expiry.

Additional conditions: the selected individual must not take up any assignment with any other organization during the contract period; no vigilance case or adverse observation from previous employers should be pending; and the candidate must have a minimum CIBIL score of 650 at the time of joining.

How to Apply

Applications are accepted online only through the bank's official website. The steps below reflect the application flow described in the notification.

  1. Visit https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and navigate to the Recruitment section on the home page.
  2. Click on the relevant notification for Cloud CoE / AI Engineers.
  3. Before starting registration, scan and prepare the following files:
    • Passport-size photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG/PNG)
    • Signature on white paper in black ink (10–20 KB)
    • Left thumb impression on white paper (20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG)
    • Hand-written declaration in English, on white paper in black ink - text: "I, [Name], hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." (50–100 KB; JPG/JPEG; NOT in capital letters)
    • Supporting documents in PDF format: Brief Resume, ID Proof, Age Proof, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates/NOC, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  4. Complete the online registration form. Keep the registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the process.
  5. Upload all documents at the specified fields. The system will not proceed until photographs and signatures meet specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate.
  7. Submit the application and save/print the system-generated application form with the registration number.
  8. Apply separately for each post if applying for more than one position.

In case of multiple submissions for the same post, only the last valid completed application will be retained; fees paid for earlier submissions will be forfeited.

Documents Required at Document Verification

Candidates called for the interview stage must bring originals and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents. Documents not produced on the day of verification will disqualify the candidate from further participation.

Required documents include: Date of Birth proof (SSC/School Leaving Certificate); printout of call letter; system-generated online application printout; all educational certificates and mark sheets from Class X onwards (semester-wise mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate); all work experience certificates and NOC from the current employer if employed with a public sector bank or government/quasi-government organization; caste/category certificates in the prescribed Government of India format (OBC certificate must be no more than one year old and contain the non-creamy layer clause); disability certificate from District Medical Board (if applicable); Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates, valid as on the date of application); two passport-size photographs identical to the one in the application; and valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, Employee ID, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted).

No documents should be sent directly to the bank before or after the interview.

Troubleshooting & Common Mistakes

Photo/Signature upload errors are among the most common reasons for application failure. Ensure your photograph is between 20 KB and 50 KB and your signature between 10 KB and 20 KB. Files larger than the specified limit will be rejected by the system. Use a scanner set to at least 200 DPI and save files in JPG/JPEG format. All supporting documents must be in PDF format.

Payment gateway failures can occur during high-traffic periods near the deadline. If a payment is deducted but the fee status is not updated, wait 24 hours and check again before attempting re-payment; duplicate payments are generally not refunded. Avoid applying on the last day to reduce the risk of server overload.

Hand-written declaration errors are a unique pitfall in this recruitment. The declaration must be in English, in the candidate's own handwriting, in lowercase (not capital letters). A typed or third-party-written declaration will invalidate the application.

Name mismatches between the application and identity documents can cause disqualification at any stage. Ensure the name (and father's/husband's name where applicable) is spelled exactly as it appears on your certificates and mark sheets. Candidates who have changed their name must produce an original Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or affidavit.

CIBIL score is a condition of joining, not selection. Candidates are advised to check their CIBIL score before applying - a score below 650 will disqualify them at the time of joining even if selected.

MSC Bank Vacancy Details – Post-wise Breakdown

MSC Bank has announced a total of 139 vacancies under four trainee categories for its 2026-27 recruitment drive. The administration reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies. The post-wise vacancy distribution is as follows:

Post Name Grade Vacancies
Trainee Junior Officer Junior Officer Grade 49
Trainee Associate Associate Grade 81
Trainee Typist Associate Grade 04
Trainee Driver Driver Grade 05
Total   139

Note: 5% reservation in Trainee Associate, Trainee Typist, and Trainee Driver posts is available for wrestlers who have represented Maharashtra at International/National level competitions and won Gold medals or been awarded Maharashtra Kesri/Hind Kesri.

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility requirements differ by post for both educational qualifications and age limits. All candidates must have passed the Matriculation Examination with Marathi as one of the subjects and must be domiciled in Maharashtra State (Domicile Certificate is mandatory). Age is calculated as on 01 June 2026.

1. Trainee Junior Officer (49 Posts)

  • Education: Graduate in any discipline with at least 50% marks. Candidates with Bachelors/Masters in Law or JAIIB/CAIIB/MSCIT certifications, or work experience in Treasury/International Banking will be preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience in Banking field, preferably in Urban/DCC Bank as an Officer (Officer Cadre — first level where Clerk level exists, or second level where it does not).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 23 years – Maximum 35 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1991).

2. Trainee Associate (81 Posts)

  • Education: Graduate in any discipline with at least 50% marks. Preference for Government Commercial Certificate in Marathi and English typing; proficiency in Computer Applications required.
  • Experience: Not mandatory; preference for candidates with Co-operative Intern experience in StCB/DCC Banks.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 21 years – Maximum 32 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1994).

3. Trainee Typist – Associate Grade (04 Posts)

  • Education: Graduate in any discipline with Marathi in Matriculation. Must possess Government Commercial Certificate Exam — 30 w.p.m. in Marathi typing and 40 w.p.m. in English typing. Proficiency in Word Processing and Spread Sheet required.
  • Experience: Not mandatory; preference for DTP Operator experience. Preference for Marathi/English stenography course holders.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 21 years – Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1998).

4. Trainee Driver (05 Posts)

  • Education: Matriculation (S.S.C.) Examination with Marathi as one of the subjects and a valid LMV licence.
  • Experience: Not mandatory.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years – Maximum 30 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1996).
  • Special relaxation: Children of MSC Bank employees get 5 years relaxation on maximum age for Trainee Driver post.

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fees are uniform for all candidate categories (no SC/ST/OBC fee waiver is mentioned in the official notification). Fees must be paid online only — no other mode is accepted — between 11 June 2026 and 01 July 2026. Fees are non-refundable once paid.

Payment can be made via Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, or Mobile Wallets. Bank transaction charges, if any, are to be borne by the candidate.

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend & Pay Scale

All selected candidates will be engaged as Trainees for 12 months, during which a monthly stipend is paid. After successful training, candidates are placed in the Bank's regular grade with revised emoluments. Post-confirmation, a probation of 6 months follows before permanent absorption.

Post Stipend During Training Emoluments After Training (Approx.)

Trainee Driver Rs. 22,000/- per month Rs. 27,700/- per month

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection methodology varies by post but all posts involve an online written examination conducted by IBPS, followed by an additional stage specific to the post. Candidates must score at least 50% (100 marks out of 200) in the written test for officer/associate posts and 50% (60 marks out of 120) for the Driver post to be shortlisted for the next round.

  2. Personal Interview by MSC Bank
  3. Final merit based on combined scores of Exam + Interview

Examination Centres

The online written test will be held at centres across Maharashtra. Candidates cannot request a change of centre once allotted. Personal Interview and Skill Test will be held at Mumbai.

Exam Centres: Mumbai / Navi Mumbai / Thane / MMR Region, Pune, Nagpur, Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nanded, and Kolhapur.

Service Bond / Consent Deposit

Candidates wondering about post-appointment obligations should note that selected candidates must execute an undertaking on Rs. 500/- stamp paper committing to serve MSC Bank for a minimum of 4 years from the date of joining. In case of default, voluntary resignation, or termination before the expiry of 4 years, the candidate is required to pay Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) as liquidated damages and execute a surety bond for Rs. 1,00,000/- from two income tax payees as sureties.

How to Apply for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026

The entire application process is online through the MSC Bank career portal. Physical applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates should keep their scanned documents ready before beginning registration.

Documents to scan before applying:

  • Photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, passport style, colour, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB)
  • Signature (black ink on white paper, 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB)
  • Left thumb impression (white paper, black/blue ink, 240×240 pixels, 20–50 KB)
  • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 50–100 KB)

Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

Step-by-step application process:

  1. Visit https://msc.bank.in/career and click "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Click "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent via SMS and email.
  3. Log in and fill the application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress at each step.
  4. Upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per specifications.
  5. Fill remaining application details and click "Validate Your Details" followed by "Save & Next".
  6. Preview the complete application using the "Preview Tab" and verify all entries.
  7. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after final verification.
  8. Proceed to the Payment Tab and pay the application fee online.
  9. Click "Submit" and save/print the e-Receipt and application form for future reference.

Only one application per candidate is allowed. In case of multiple applications, only the latest will be retained and earlier fees will be forfeited.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Many applicants lose their candidature due to avoidable errors during or after the application process. Review the following checklist before submitting your form.

  • Applying for multiple posts: MSC Bank allows one application per candidate. Submit only one application for the post you are most qualified for.
  • Wrong photograph format: Passport-style colour photo against a light background is required. Selfies, group photos, or blurred images will lead to rejection.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS: Signatures in block/capital letters are strictly rejected. Sign in your normal cursive style with black ink.
  • Missing Domicile Certificate: Only Maharashtra residents can apply. Ensure your Domicile Certificate is valid and ready for document verification.
  • Not checking Marathi in SSC: All posts require Marathi as a subject in Matriculation. Check your mark sheet before applying.
  • Pressing Back/Refresh during payment: After submitting payment information, do not press Back or Refresh. Wait for the server confirmation to avoid double charges.
  • Incomplete scanning of thumb impression: The left thumb impression must be properly scanned and not smudged. A blurred or partial impression can invalidate your application.
  • Not saving the e-Receipt: If an e-Receipt is not generated, the transaction may have failed. Log in again and repeat the payment process.

How to Download RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 at rbi.org.in?

How can I download my RBI Grade B Phase 1 Call Letter 2026 from rbi.org.in?

  3. Step 3: Open the "Current Vacancies" tab and look for the Call Letters / Admit Card link.

What Is CSEB Kerala? - Understanding the Recruitment Process

The Cooperative Service Examination Board (CSEB), Kerala, is the state body that conducts recruitment examinations for vacancies in Kerala's cooperative banks and societies. Unlike PSC (Public Service Commission) which recruits for government departments, CSEB specifically handles the cooperative sector.

The recruitment process works in two layers:

  1. CSEB conducts the written examination and prepares a ranked list of qualified candidates for each advertisement
  2. The individual cooperative bank/society conducts the interview from the shortlisted candidates and makes the final appointment

This means that after you clear the written exam, the specific bank where the vacancy exists will call you for an interview. Final appointment is made by that bank - you are an employee of the cooperative bank, not a Kerala Government employee. However, the salary scales, service conditions, and regulations are governed by the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act and rules.

Why Apply for a Kerala Cooperative Bank Job?

Many candidates overlook cooperative bank jobs while focusing only on PSC or central government posts. Here is why CSEB recruitment deserves serious consideration:

  • Stable, permanent employment governed by the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act
  • Pay scales competitive with state government Level equivalents for the same qualifications
  • Local posting - most cooperative banks post staff within the district or region, unlike state government transfers
  • Less competition than PSC exams - the candidate pool for CSEB exams is significantly smaller than for state-level PSC recruitments
  • Multiple banks in one advertisement - you can apply to multiple institutions in the same advt by paying an additional ₹50 per bank, increasing your selection chances significantly
  • Fresher-friendly - the Junior Clerk posts especially have no experience requirement

Tips for CSEB Written Exam Preparation

  • The 100-question, 100-mark written exam typically covers: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Kerala-specific awareness, Cooperative law and principles, Mathematics/Reasoning, and English/Malayalam language
  • For Secretary and Assistant Secretary posts, expect questions on cooperative management, accounting principles, banking regulations, and the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act in depth
  • For Junior Clerk posts, the pattern is closer to a standard clerical aptitude test - reasoning, basic arithmetic, language comprehension
  • For System Administrator, expect technical questions on networking, OS administration, database management, and IT security alongside cooperative awareness
  • For DEO, expect typing/computer knowledge components alongside the written test
  • The minimum qualifying score is low (4/20 for interview eligibility) but the real competition is in clearing the cutoff that gets you called for an interview - typically much higher in popular banks. Focus on scoring in the top tier rather than just qualifying.

Can You Apply for Multiple Banks in the Same Advertisement?

Yes - and this is a significant strategic advantage. Unlike most government recruitment processes where you apply to one organization, the CSEB system allows a single candidate to apply to multiple cooperative banks under the same advertisement number. Each additional bank beyond the first requires an extra ₹50 exam fee.

For example, under Advt. 17/2026 (Junior Clerk – Super Grade), if you want to be considered for 3 banks, you pay: ₹150 (first bank) + ₹50 + ₹50 = ₹250 (+ 18% GST).

This is particularly useful for candidates who are flexible about work location within Kerala, as it dramatically increases the number of vacancies you are effectively competing for.

Position UR OBC (NCL) Total

Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions (qualification, experience, and age) as on the prescribed dates. Only Indian Citizens are eligible to apply. Candidates having completed their graduation/post-graduation through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are NOT eligible. For CGPA-based grading, candidates must provide a conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet/certificate.

Criteria Details
Nationality Indian Citizens only.
Essential Academic Qualification Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Full-time B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.E./M.C.A. in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication from a University/Institute recognized/approved by Government/AICTE/UGC.
Essential Experience Minimum 1 year of experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank or All India Financial Institution or any other organization of repute, in Information Security functions.
Preferred Certifications Preference given to candidates possessing any one of: CISA / CISM / CISSP / OSCP / CEH / CISP / CRTP / CCNA / CCNP / ISO 27001:2022 LA/LI / CompTIA Security+.
Additional Skills Excellent communication skills and proficiency in computers and information technology.
Not Eligible Candidates who completed graduation/post-graduation through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are not eligible.
OBC Non-Creamy Layer OBC certificate must specifically contain a clause of non-creamy layer exclusion from GoI reservation benefits. Certificate must be valid as on last date of applying (issued within one year prior to last date). Caste name must tally letter by letter with Central Government list. OBC Creamy Layer candidates and those whose caste is not in Central List must apply as General.
Government Employees Candidates already in service must produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original from present employer at the time of joining, failing which they will not be allowed to join.
Service Bond Selected candidates must execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 5 years from date of joining.

Candidates must be not below 21 years and not above 28 years as on 01-05-2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Creamy Layer) candidates must apply under General category and are not entitled to age relaxation.

Sr. No. Category Maximum Age (as on 01-05-2026)
1 General (UR) / EWS 28 years
2 OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 31 years (3 years relaxation)
3 Persons with Disabilities (PwBDs) 10 years relaxation over General limit
4 Ex-Servicemen 5 years relaxation (as per DOPT circular No. 36034/2/2013 dated 08-04-2013, for Group A direct recruitment through All India Competitive Examination)

Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fees and intimation charges are non-refundable. The process of registration is complete only when fee is deposited through online mode on or before the last date i.e. 21-06-2026. Bank transaction charges for online payment will have to be borne by the candidate. Fee once paid will not be refunded even if the applicant is not found eligible.

Category Application Fee / Intimation Charges
General / OBC (NCL) Rs. 600/- (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD / EWS / Female candidates (all communities) Rs. 100/- (Intimation Charges only - Non-Refundable)

Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on Written Test followed by Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on written test performance will be called for Personal Interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance in both stages. Written Examination carries 70% weightage and Personal Interview carries 30% weightage in the final merit list. There will be no sectional cut-off in the written test. Exim Bank will analyse responses to detect patterns of similarity - if copying is inferred, candidature will be cancelled.

Stage 1 - Written Test (Professional Knowledge - Objective Type)

Name of the Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
Professional Knowledge - Objective (Part I: Information Technology and Cyber Security) 100 100 2 Hours 30 Minutes

Candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours (including time for document verification, instructions, etc.). No request for change of centre/venue/date/session will be entertained. Examination centres: Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad (may change if sufficient candidates not available). Personal Interviews will be conducted only in Mumbai and New Delhi. Written test carries 70% weightage; Interview carries 30% weightage in final merit.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written test performance will be called for Personal Interview at Mumbai or New Delhi. Candidates must produce original degree certificates, caste, experience and other relevant certificates at the time of interview. Candidates already in service must carry a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager (Information Security) Recruitment 2026 - Pre-Recruitment Training

A pre-recruitment training will be organized for candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online/offline) will be intimated to candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared after the last date of registration.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.E./M.C.A. in Computer Science/IT/Electronics & Communication - degrees from other disciplines or part-time/distance/correspondence courses are strictly ineligible.
  • Candidates with aggregate marks below 60% in their qualifying degree - the 60% minimum is a hard eligibility condition.
  • Candidates who do not have at least 1 year of post-qualification experience in Information Security functions in a Scheduled Commercial Bank, All India Financial Institution, or other organization of repute - experience in unrelated IT roles does not qualify.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21 to 28 years as on 01-05-2026 (except those entitled to OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC Creamy Layer candidates expecting OBC reservation or age relaxation - they must apply as General.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting is at the Bank's requirement at any location in India including transfers to overseas offices with consent.
  • Candidates who cannot commit to the 5-year service bond of Rs. 3 lakh - this bond is mandatory and must be executed at the time of joining.
  • Candidates currently in government service who cannot produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their employer at the time of joining - they will not be allowed to join without it.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Uploading a signature in CAPITAL LETTERS - capital letter signatures are not accepted and will lead to rejection.
  • Not writing the handwritten declaration personally in English - if written by anyone else or in any other language, the application will be declared invalid.
  • Not uploading a live photograph via webcam/mobile at the time of filling the application - this is mandatory in addition to the static scanned photograph.
  • Uploading blurry, smudged, or unclear photograph, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration - such applications may be rejected; candidates should preview all uploads before final submission.
  • Not cross-checking that the name in the application exactly matches the name on the photo identity proof - any mismatch leads to denial of entry at the examination/interview; female candidates who have changed name post-marriage must be especially careful.
  • Clicking Back or Refresh during online fee payment - this may cause double charges; wait for server intimation after payment submission.
  • Not taking a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form after fee payment - this is required for future reference.
  • Not keeping the email ID and mobile number active till the end of the recruitment process - all communications including admit card, call letters, and results are sent only via email/SMS.
  • Not furnishing the CGPA conversion formula/letter from University/Institute if degree is CGPA-based - without this, the equivalent percentage cannot be verified and candidature may be rejected.
  • Waiting till the last date to apply - the Bank is not responsible for website outages or connectivity issues; candidates must apply well before 21-06-2026.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must apply online only through the link available on the Bank's Careers page at https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers. The application link will be live from 26-05-2026. No other means or mode of application will be accepted. Before applying, candidates must scan and keep ready all required documents. The application registration is complete only when fee is successfully paid online on or before 21-06-2026.

Documents to be Scanned and Uploaded before applying:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 200×230 pixels preferred; 20 KB–50 KB; JPEG) - light/white background, no caps, dark glasses or religious headwear covering face
  • Live photograph - to be captured via webcam or mobile phone QR scan at the time of filling the application form (mandatory in addition to static photo)
  • Signature with Black Ink on white paper (140×60 pixels preferred; 10 KB–20 KB; JPEG/JPG) - NOT in CAPITAL LETTERS
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with Black or Blue ink (240×240 pixels in 200 DPI preferred; 20 KB–50 KB; JPEG/JPG)
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with Black ink (800×400 pixels in 200 DPI preferred; 50 KB–100 KB; JPEG/JPG) - in candidate's own handwriting only
  • Consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation & Post-Graduation (PDF; 20 KB–500 KB)
  • Graduation & Post-Graduation Degree Certificate (PDF; 20 KB–500 KB)
  • Caste Certificate - if applicable (PDF; 20 KB–500 KB)

Documents to be Produced in Original at the time of Written Examination / Interview:

  • Call Letter (downloaded from Bank's website) with original and photocopy of currently valid photo identity proof bearing exactly the same name as on the call letter - valid IDs: PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Photo identity proof issued by Gazetted Officer on official letterhead, Photo identity proof issued by People's Representative on official letterhead, valid College/University Identity Card, Aadhaar Card/E-Aadhaar with photograph, Employee ID, or Bar Council Identity Card. (Note: Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid.)
  • Original degree certificates, caste certificate, experience certificates, and any other relevant certificates (at the time of interview)
  • In case of name change - original Gazette notification, original marriage certificate, or affidavit in original
  • CGPA conversion letter from Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if CGPA-based grading)
  • Scribe undertaking and disability/medical certificate (for PwBD candidates requesting scribe facility - must be registered for scribe and compensatory time in online application form)

The handwritten declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

Candidates are advised to take a printout of the system-generated online application form after registration. No change/alteration is possible after clicking COMPLETE REGISTRATION. Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai - Mumbai courts/tribunals/forums shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.

Apply Online at: https://www.eximbankindia.in/careers

Important Instructions for Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Application link will be live from 26-05-2026 and closes on 21-06-2026 - apply well in advance without waiting for the last date.
  • Registration is complete only when fee is paid online on or before 21-06-2026. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Candidates must carry the call letter along with original and a photocopy of currently valid photo identity proof to the examination and interview - without these, entry will not be permitted.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo identity proof - female candidates who have changed name post-marriage must note this carefully.
  • Candidates reporting late after the reporting time on the call letter will NOT be permitted to take the examination.
  • No request for change of examination centre/venue/date/session will be entertained.
  • Mobile phones (even in switched-off mode), pagers, or any electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall - violation leads to disqualification and possible debarment from future Exim Bank recruitments.
  • Exim Bank will analyse response patterns - if response sharing is detected, candidature will be cancelled and results withheld.
  • Pre-recruitment training will be organized for reserved category candidates who opt for it in the online application form.
  • PwBD candidates requiring a scribe must arrange their own scribe at their own cost and must indicate the requirement in the online application form - subsequent requests may not be entertained. Eligible PwBD/locomotor disability/visually impaired candidates get 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour.
  • Selected candidates must execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from date of joining.
  • Selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India as per Bank's requirement and may be transferred to overseas offices with consent.
  • Candidates already in service must produce a relieving letter/discharge certificate from present employer at the time of joining - without it, joining will not be permitted.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • All matters regarding eligibility, selection process, results, etc. - the Bank's decision is final and binding. No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible or non-selected candidates.
  • Legal proceedings can only be instituted in Mumbai - Mumbai courts/tribunals/forums have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.

MSC Bank Specialized Branch Manager & Manager (Contract) Recruitment 2026-27 – Selection Process

For both posts, applications will be screened/scrutinized on the basis of eligibility criteria as mentioned in the respective advertisements. Shortlisted eligible candidates will be called for a series of interviews (Specialized Branch Manager) or Interview/Discussion process (Manager – Contract). Candidature will be cancelled if any information furnished in the application is found false, incorrect, or incomplete. Final offer letter will be issued after successful completion of Background Verification, Police Verification, Medical Examination, and Document Validation.

Post-Selection Steps (Specialized Branch Manager – Regular):

  • Preliminary Offer Letter issued to qualified candidates.
  • Background Verification, Police Verification, Medical Examination, and Documentation.
  • Final Offer Letter issued after successful completion of all mandatory procedures.
  • Probation Period: 6 months; confirmed in the respective post after successful completion.
  • Selected candidates must execute an undertaking on Rs. 500/- stamp paper committing to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining. In case of default/voluntary resignation before completion of 5 years, liquidated damages of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) are payable to the Bank. Surety bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- each from two income tax payees is also required.

Post-Selection Steps (Manager – Contract):

  • First appointment on contract for 1 year; extendable up to a maximum of 5 years based on performance assessment.
  • Either party must give one month's notice or pay one month's fixed component of compensation to terminate the contract before expiry.
  • Appointment subject to being declared medically fit as per Bank's requirements.

Leaves 12 days Casual Leave per year (1 CL per month of service); 15 days Privilege Leave per calendar year with prior approval from Competent Authority
Outstation Official Duties Travelling expenses / Halting allowance / hotel stay eligibility as per Bank's T.A.D.A. Rules & Regulations
Working Hours As applicable to serving employees of the Bank
Job Profile Middle management level officer; managing banking staff; supervising branch performance; executing tasks assigned by Bank Management from time to time
Place of Posting Regional Offices and Head Office, Mumbai; Bank reserves right to transfer as per business requirement
PF / Gratuity / Pension Not applicable for contract engagement
Regular Absorption No legal claim to regular absorption during or after contract period

Who should NOT apply for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have not passed the JAIIB examination (for Specialized Branch Manager) or the CAIIB examination (for Manager – Contract) — these are hard mandatory requirements.
  • Candidates without at least 5 years of experience as a Branch Manager at Officer level in a commercial/co-op bank (for Specialized Branch Manager).
  • Candidates without at least 10–12 years of experience at Senior/Middle Management level in a commercial/co-op bank (for Manager – Contract).
  • Candidates who are not domiciled in Maharashtra State — Maharashtra domicile certificate is compulsory for both posts; non-Maharashtra residents cannot apply.
  • Candidates who are below 45 years of age as on 01-05-2026 — both posts have a minimum age of 45 years.
  • Candidates for Manager (Contract) who are above 62 years of age as on 01-05-2026.
  • Candidates unwilling to be posted/transferred anywhere in Maharashtra — all services are liable to be transferred.
  • Candidates for Specialized Branch Manager who are unwilling to execute the 5-year service bond and pay Rs. 10 Lakh as liquidated damages in case of early exit.
  • Government/PSU/Bank employees who have not informed their employer in writing about applying for this recruitment — submission of employer information copy is a mandatory requirement.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not downloading both Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form) from https://msc.bank.in/career — both must be filled and submitted together.
  • Not enclosing the Maharashtra Domicile Certificate with the application — applications without it will be treated as ineligible.
  • Not enclosing self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents (educational certificates, JAIIB/CAIIB certificate, experience certificates, date of birth proof) — applications without mandatory enclosures will not be considered.
  • Candidates currently in Government/PSU/Bank service not enclosing a copy of their employer intimation letter (informing their Head of Office/Department about the application) — this is a mandatory requirement.
  • Super-scribing the envelope incorrectly — the envelope must be clearly super-scribed as "Application for the post of Specialized Branch Managers" (Advt. 01) or "Application for the post of Managers (Contract)" (Advt. 02) respectively.
  • Applying for both posts in a single envelope or under a single application — each post requires a separate application as per respective advertisement instructions.
  • Not providing a definite timeline/proof for relieving from the current employer if selected — this must be mentioned with documentary proof in the application.
  • Not providing references of two important professionals/Government officials as required in the application form.

How to Apply for MSC Bank Specialized Branch Manager & Manager (Contract) Recruitment 2026-27

Applications must be submitted offline only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Candidates must visit the Bank's website https://msc.bank.in/career, download Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form), fill them in all respects, and send by Post / Speed Post / Courier along with all mandatory self-attested documents.

Documents to be Enclosed (Self-Attested Photocopies):

  • Proof of Date of Birth
  • Educational Certificates and Mark Sheets (from 10th standard onwards)
  • JAIIB Certificate (for Specialized Branch Manager) / CAIIB Certificate (for Manager – Contract)
  • Experience Certificates (containing area, organization, and period of service) for all relevant work experience
  • Maharashtra State Domicile Certificate (compulsory)
  • Copies of relevant published work / research papers (if any, for Manager – Contract)
  • Copy of letter informing employer about this application (mandatory for candidates in Government/PSU/Bank service)
  • Proof of definite timeline for relieving from current employer (if selected)
  • Passport-size photograph affixed on the application form (sign across; do not pin/staple)

Application to be sent to (for BOTH posts):

Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan,

Important Instructions for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27 Candidates

  • Applications must reach the Bank on or before 22-06-2026 by 05:15 PM. Incomplete applications and those received after this deadline will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Submission of Maharashtra State Domicile Certificate is compulsory. Applications without it will not be considered.
  • Candidates in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Financial Institutions/Banks service must inform their employer (Head of Office/Department) in writing about their application and attach a photocopy of the intimation letter with the application, prior to submission.
  • At the time of joining, recommended candidates must produce a proper discharge certificate from their employer.
  • Any external influence/canvassing regarding appointment or transfer shall be treated as a violation of Bank rules and the Bank reserves the right to cancel such candidature.
  • For Specialized Branch Manager: Selected candidates must execute an undertaking to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years. Liquidated damages of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) are payable on voluntary resignation/termination before 5 years. Surety bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- each from two income tax payees is also mandatory.
  • For Manager (Contract): The engagement shall not be construed as employment in the Bank. No PF/Gratuity/Pension provisions are applicable. There is no legal claim to regular absorption during or after the contract period.
  • Officers who are confirmed in the services of MSC Bank and fulfill the eligibility criteria are also eligible to apply for both posts.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirements.
  • Candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage if any information provided is found to be false/incorrect/incomplete.
  • No TA will be paid to candidates called for interview.
  • Corrigendum, if any, will be published only on the Bank's website https://msc.bank.in/career.
  • Any dispute arising from this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of Courts at Mumbai only.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply

Candidates must apply Online only through the Bank's official website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before filling the application, candidates must mandatorily read the notification and instructions carefully.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

Step 1: Visit the Bank's official website https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in and open the link "BDCC RECRUITMENT 2026" on a desktop/laptop computer. Read the notification and instructions carefully before filling the application.

  • After clicking the registration box, a confirmation check box will appear for candidates who have previously applied and paid the fee. Those candidates must re-submit the application with the same registration number clearly mentioned, upload documents, and re-submit.
  • A check box will appear: "Are you re-applying after already submitting an application and fee payment?" If Yes, mention the previous application registration number clearly, upload documents, and re-submit the application.

Step 2: Visit http://www.bellarydcc.bank.in, register and log in. Enter your SSLC marks, name, date of birth, disability status, and other required details. Verify mobile number and email ID via OTP. Register successfully.

  • Candidates who previously applied and downloaded the application under the earlier notification must register again with a new registration number and re-upload documents per the new requirements. Fee once paid for the earlier application is not refunded, and no separate fee is required again for that post.

Step 3: Use your registration number and date of birth as login credentials. Review and edit all details and qualification information if needed. Preview the application carefully before confirming. Once submitted, no information can be changed.

Step 4: Upload Photo and Signature. The candidate must upload their passport-size photograph on a blank white paper with signature below using a black Sketch/Marker pen; scan and upload. Applications without photo/signature or incomplete applications will be rejected.

  • After uploading photo and signature, upload all required SSLC marks/reservation-related documents with self-attestation, then submit.

Step 5: After submitting, pay the application fee and applicable gateway charges through the Payment Gateway link.

Photo Specifications:

  • File size: Less than 100 KB
  • DPI Setting: 100 DPI
  • Quality: 100%
  • Color: Color
  • Format: JPG/JPEG
  • Photo size: 35mm × 45mm; Signature below: 35mm × 20mm

  2. SSLC marks card / School attendance certificate or Cumulative Record Extract (for date of birth proof).

  3. Candidates currently employed: Service certificate from employer and No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the relevant recruitment authority.
  4. Kalyana Karnataka Region candidates: Eligibility proof certificate as per Annexure-2 from the authorized sub-divisional authority.
  5. Rural candidates: Certificate in Form-1 and General candidates in Form-1 and Form-2 from the concerned Tahsildar.
  6. Differently-Abled candidates: Medical certificate from the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format.
  7. Manager / First Division Assistant post: All year/semester mark sheets of the degree.
  8. Second Division Assistant post: Second PUC mark sheets / current student proof.
  9. Vehicle Driver post: SSLC marks card and valid legal driving license.
  10. Junior Servant post: SSLC marks card.

They must clearly mention the previous registration number and re-upload all required documents. No separate fee payment is required for those posts.

  • Information regarding re-application will be communicated via SMS and email to the registered mobile number and email ID of candidates who had previously applied and downloaded their application under the earlier notification.

Caste Reservation Certificate Requirements

For candidates claiming reservation benefits:

  • SC (Category A, B, C) / ST / Pangada candidates: Upload certificate in Form-D
  • Category-1 candidates: Upload certificate in Form-E
  • Category-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates: Upload certificate in Form-F, obtained from the concerned Tahsildar; these certificates for Backward Hindu categories must be valid within 5 years from the date of application.

Rural Candidate Reservation:

  • Rural candidates must have studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a village (rural area) under the current rules; certificate must be current and valid.
  • SC/ST/Pangada candidates claiming Rural reservation must submit Form-2 rural reservation certificate.
  • General category candidates claiming rural reservation must submit Form-1 rural certificate along with proof that they are not otherwise listed as urban.
  • General category, SC/ST/Pangada, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates who fail to submit the required rural reservation certificate will be treated as ineligible for rural reservation.
  • Note: Certificate in Form-2 must be obtained from the Headmaster of the school where the candidate studied and attested by the concerned field education officer.

Kannada Medium Candidates:

  • Candidates claiming Kannada Medium reservation must submit a certificate from the Headmaster of the school where they studied Kannada medium along with date of school's issue, signed certificate, and must be held valid as on the last date of application. Original copies must be produced at verification. If not produced, the Kannada Medium reservation will be cancelled.

Scheme-Deprived (Yojane Nirashritha) Candidates:

  • Must produce a certificate from the concerned Tahsildar in the prescribed format as per current rules. Certificate must be valid up to the last date of application and must be current.

Ex-Servicemen:

  • Ex-Serviceman means a person who has served in any rank (combatant or non-combatant) in the Central Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) - excluding persons who served in Defence Security Corps, General Reserve Engineering Force, Lok Sahayak Sena, and Para-Military Forces.
  • Family members (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) of persons who died while serving in Central Armed Forces are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation; however, age relaxation will not be provided to them.
  • Eligible cases for Ex-Servicemen reservation:
    • Retired voluntarily from such service after receiving pension; OR
    • Released from military service on medical grounds with medical and physical disability pension; OR
    • Released from service due to reduction of personnel; OR
    • Released from service after completing specific service and receiving gratuity, after fulfilling period of service - including: persons retired from continuous service, persons with physical disability due to military service, and gazette prize winners.
  • Persons currently re-employed in government service after retiring from military service must apply for military reservation through their current service NOC before appointment; they are allowed to enjoy all benefits available to ex-servicemen during re-employment, but the bank will not be responsible if they are not matched with the post. They must submit their discharge certificate before applying.
  • Ex-servicemen applicants, persons dependent on ex-servicemen who were killed or permanently disabled while in service - (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) - are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation benefits. Age relaxation will not be provided to dependents. They must submit the discharge certificate and permanence/gratuity certificate; at the time of original document verification, original copies must be produced.

Differently-Abled (Physically Challenged) Candidates:

  • Only candidates with a minimum of 40% benchmark disability certified by the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format (NOT in any other format) are eligible for differently-abled reservation. Certificate must be issued in the prescribed Government notification format.
  • Differently-Abled candidates who require a scribe for the written examination must upload a special medical certificate from the Medical Board stating that they are unable to write due to physical disability.
  • The scribe requirement must be indicated at the time of application in the specified field in the online application; only when required, the candidate may request a scribe from the examination centre authority.

Who Should NOT Apply for Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the prescribed educational qualifications (degree for Manager/FDA; Second PUC for SDA; SSLC for Driver and Junior Servant) as on the last date of application.

  • Candidates who cannot read, write, speak, and understand Kannada - knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all posts.
  • Candidates below 18 years of age or above the maximum age limit applicable to their category.
  • OBC (Category-2A/2B/3A/3B) Creamy Layer candidates applying under reserved categories - only non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • Candidates with less than 40% disability who apply for Differently-Abled reservation - only 40%+ benchmark disability qualifies.
  • Vehicle Driver candidates who do not hold a valid legal driving license.
  • Candidates currently employed in any organization who cannot produce an NOC from their employer.
  • Candidates who obtained degrees or certificates from institutions declared fake or derecognized by competent educational authorities - such applications will be rejected at any stage.
  • Candidates who provide false information or suppress facts - such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution and disqualification at any stage of the selection process.
  • Persons who are members of or active in any banned organization, or who have attempted to overthrow the Government of India, or who have been convicted under any law, or who have taken part in activities against the sovereignty or integrity of India, or who have been dismissed from any government service.
  • Candidates with mental illness or mental disability.
  • A male candidate who has more than one living wife, and a woman candidate who has married a man who already has another living wife, are not eligible.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for the wrong post for which you do not meet the educational qualification.

  • Selecting the wrong category (General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) - categories cannot be changed after submission; mismatched certificates lead to cancellation.
  • OBC (Backward Hindu 2A/2B/3A/3B) candidates from Creamy Layer applying under OBC reservation instead of General category.
  • Not uploading all mandatory documents at the time of online application - incomplete applications will be rejected outright.
  • Uploading blurred, illegible, or incorrect photographs, signatures, or certificates - leading to rejection at document verification stage.
  • Using an inactive or wrong mobile number and email ID - exam dates, interview schedules, and admit cards are communicated only through SMS and email.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post without following the proper Re-submit process - only the last valid application is considered and fees for others are forfeited.
  • Not reading the separate instructions for candidates who applied under the earlier notification (06.04.2026) - they must re-apply with their old registration number and need not pay fee again for the same post.
  • Not noting that each post requires a separate application and separate fee - applying for multiple posts with a single application/fee is not permitted.
  • Paying the fee through DD/Postal Order/Money Order or any offline mode - only online payment (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/Google Pay) is accepted.
  • Not keeping originals of all uploaded documents ready for verification - originals must be produced at the time of interview/verification.
  • Ignoring the minimum qualifying mark requirement: candidates must score a minimum of 85 out of 100 (or 200) in the written examination to qualify for the interview.
