Selection Process: How Candidates Will Be Chosen

Selection for these IT Specialized Officer posts is interview-based, with no written examination stage. After the interview, shortlisted candidates go through a multi-step verification process before receiving a final appointment.

  1. Eligibility Screening – Applications are scrutinized against the post-specific eligibility criteria; only eligible candidates are shortlisted.
  2. Interview – Shortlisted candidates appear for a direct interview for the specific post they applied for.
  3. Preliminary Offer Letter – Issued to candidates who qualify in the interview.
  4. Verification Stage – Candidates undergo Background Verification, Police Verification, Medical Examination, and Documentation.
  5. Final Offer Letter – Issued once all verification steps are successfully completed.
  6. Probation Period – Selected candidates serve a 6-month probation, after which they are confirmed in their respective post.

The notification does not specify exact timelines between these stages; the interview date will be communicated directly to eligible candidates after screening.

Documents and Service Bond Requirements

Beyond the application form itself, candidates need to prepare supporting documents and understand the service commitment attached to this recruitment. This is an area where incomplete submissions commonly lead to rejection.

  • Self-attested photocopies of all relevant qualification and experience certificates must be enclosed with the application.
  • A domicile certificate of Maharashtra State is compulsory, since only Maharashtra residents are eligible to apply.
  • A recent passport-size photograph must be affixed (not pinned or stapled) to Annexure-1.
  • Selected candidates must execute an undertaking on ₹500 stamp paper committing to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Breach of this undertaking requires payment of ₹10 lakh as liquidated damages upon demand, along with two surety bonds of ₹1 lakh each from two income-tax-paying sureties.
  • Candidates currently employed in government departments, PSUs, banks, or financial institutions must inform their employer in writing before applying and attach proof of this with the application.
  • At the time of joining, selected candidates must produce a proper discharge certificate from their previous employer.

How to Apply: Offline Application Process

This recruitment does not have an "Apply Online" option - every application must be physically posted to the Bank. Following the steps below in order helps avoid the most common submission errors.

  1. Visit the Bank's career page at https://msc.bank.in/career.
  2. Download Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form).
  3. Fill in all details completely and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
  4. Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant qualification and experience certificates.
  5. Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the post of [post name]."
  6. Send the sealed application via Post / Speed Post / Courier to:
    The Deputy General Manager (O.S.D.), HRD&M Department, The Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd., Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, 9, Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce Lane, Fort, Mumbai – 400001, Post Box No. 472.
  7. Ensure the application physically reaches the Bank on or before 08.07.2026, up to 5:15 PM - postmark dates are not mentioned as sufficient.

Candidates can apply for only one post, so the post name should be decided before filling the form.

Special Eligibility Rules for Existing MSC Bank Employees

Current MSC Bank staff interested in these posts face a different set of conditions than external applicants, which is worth knowing before applying internally.

  • Applicants must first obtain written permission from the Bank, including prior approval of the Managing Director routed through their Department Incharge and the HRDM Manager.
  • Confirmed employees who meet all eligibility criteria can apply but are not entitled to any concession.
  • Official leave must be taken to attend the interview.
  • If selected in the immediate senior grade, salary is fixed as per prevailing practice based on regular service, excluding any Special Workload Allowance from the previous grade.
  • Employees applying for a post above their immediate seniority must resign from their current role after selection, following standard resignation rules.
  • Instead of the 5-year bond, internally selected employees execute an undertaking on ₹500 stamp paper to serve the Bank until retirement or superannuation.

Common Mistakes to Avoid When Applying

These are practical pitfalls based on how this recruitment is structured, meant to help candidates submit a clean application the first time.

  • Assuming this recruitment has an online portal - it is offline only, and any "apply online" claim for this advertisement should be treated with caution.
  • Forgetting to attach the Maharashtra domicile certificate, which is compulsory, not optional documentation.
  • Pinning or stapling the photograph on Annexure-1 instead of simply affixing it as instructed.
  • Applying for more than one post, since only single-post applications are accepted.
  • Sending unattested photocopies instead of self-attested ones.
  • Failing to inform a current government, PSU, or bank employer in writing before submitting the application.
  • Overlooking the one-year window to acquire a mandatory certification when it isn't already held.
  • Posting the application close to the deadline without accounting for postal transit time - the form must reach the Bank by 5:15 PM on 08.07.2026, not just be sent by that date.

PDC Bank Recruitment 2026: Competition Level Analysis

Competition for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026 will vary sharply by post, mainly due to the difference in vacancy count and the experience criteria attached to each role.

The Clerk post, with 100 vacancies and no prior experience requirement, is open to all fresh graduates meeting the 55% marks criterion and is expected to draw the highest volume of applications among all nine posts. The Junior Officer post, with 30 vacancies, also has a wide vacancy spread but is restricted to candidates with at least 3 years of relevant front-line banking experience, which narrows the applicant pool compared to Clerk. At the other end, posts such as General Manager (1 vacancy), Assistant General Manager (2), and Manager (2) demand 3 to 8+ years of managerial-level cooperative or commercial banking experience, which limits the eligible pool to seasoned banking professionals - even though the absolute number of applicants will be lower, competition per seat remains intense given how few vacancies are available at the senior level.

Who Should NOT Apply for PDC Bank Recruitment 2026

Based strictly on the eligibility conditions in the notification, candidates falling into the following categories should not apply, as their applications are likely to be rejected:

  • Candidates who do not meet the minimum or maximum age limit specified for the post as on 1 July 2026, particularly Clerk applicants outside the 20-30 year range, since no age relaxation applies to this post.
  • Candidates who completed their graduation or post-graduation by taking extra semesters or years beyond the minimum duration declared by their university/board to clear a backlog or ATKT - the notification explicitly excludes such candidates.
  • Candidates who do not hold the minimum years of relevant cooperative/commercial banking experience required for the specific post (for example, applying for Deputy General Manager without 5+ years of managerial experience).
  • Candidates who do not have, and cannot arrange, online payment facilities such as UPI, since only online fee payment is accepted.

Many otherwise eligible candidates risk rejection or loss of the non-refundable fee due to avoidable errors. Keep these points in mind before submitting the application:

  • Sending a hard copy or offline application - the bank will accept only online applications for every post.
  • Not saving the UPI payment confirmation/receipt after paying the application fee, which the notification specifically asks candidates to retain.

Pune People's Co-Op Bank Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be based on the candidate's qualifications and experience. The Board of Directors reserves the right to relax the conditions in respect of candidates. The general selection flow is:

  • Step 1 – Application Screening: Applications are screened based on post-wise eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age).
  • Step 2 – Shortlisting: Candidates with higher qualifications than stipulated will be given preference. Computer literacy is mandatory for all posts.
  • Step 3 – Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at the Head Office or a designated location. Date and venue will be communicated by the bank.
  • Step 4 – Document Verification: Original documents will be verified at the time of interview or joining.

Who Should NOT Apply for Pune People's Co-Op Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the minimum experience requirements for the post applied for - the bank explicitly requires verified years of relevant banking experience for all posts.
  • Fresh graduates with no work experience - all posts require a minimum of 1 year (Graphic Designer) to 15 years (Chief Law Officer) of relevant experience.
  • Candidates above the age limit specified for their post, unless the Board decides to grant relaxation.
  • Candidates applying for legal posts (DGM Chief Law Officer / Branch Manager Legal Officer) who do not hold LLB/LLM qualifications - other qualifications are not acceptable for these posts.
  • Candidates who are not computer literate - computer literacy is a mandatory requirement for all posts without exception.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted at any of the bank's locations across Pune, Belgaum, Thane, or Chh. Sambhaji Nagar.
  • Candidates who cannot submit a physical application by post to the Head Office within 10 days of the advertisement date - no online application mode is available.
  • Candidates applying for Branch Manager (Board Secretary) who are not proficient in both English and Marathi correspondence.
  • Candidates for Steno/Typist post who cannot type at 40 w.p.m. in English - this is a minimum threshold, not a preferred standard.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying

What Is the RRB ALP Correction Form 2026?

The RRB ALP Correction Form 2026 is an official modification facility provided by Indian Railways that allows registered candidates to review and correct mistakes made in their online application for the RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) CEN 01/2026 recruitment. The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) have opened a special CCAA Modification Window 2026 for candidates under CEN No. 08/2024, popularly known as RRB Group D recruitment. The window is open from 17 June 2026 (00:01 hrs) to 23 June 2026 (23:59 hrs), allowing eligible Course Completed Act Apprentice (CCAA) candidates who appeared in the CBT but had not entered their NCVT examination marks to update this information online before the deadline closes.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

This is a one-time, time-bound opportunity. If you are a CCAA candidate and missed filling in your NCVT marks at the time of applying, this article explains exactly who can use this window, what you need to update, the step-by-step process, and what happens if you miss the deadline.

Click Here: RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026

RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026 - Key Highlights

This section gives a quick snapshot of the most important facts about the modification window the recruitment body, notification number, opening and closing dates, and who it applies to so you can confirm at a glance whether this update concerns you.

Detail Information
Recruitment Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB)
Notification Number CEN No. 08/2024 (Level-1 / Group D)
Total Vacancies (CEN 08/2024) 32,438
Window Opens 17 June 2026, 00:01 hrs
Window Closes 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs
Eligible Candidates CCAA candidates who appeared in CBT but did not furnish NCVT marks
Official Notice Date 16 June 2026
Purpose Updating NCVT certificate details and marks for CCAA quota benefits

Who Are CCAAs and Why Does This Update Matter?

Before looking at eligibility and steps, it helps to understand who qualifies as a CCAA and why updating NCVT details carries real weight in the RRB Group D selection process.

Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAAs) are candidates who have completed their apprenticeship training in a Railway Establishment under the Apprentices Act. CCAAs trained in a Railway Establishment receive two specific advantages over general candidates in the RRB Group D selection process:

  • NCVT marks weightage: Marks obtained in the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) examination are given due weightage while preparing the final merit list after the CBT.
  • PET exemption: CCAAs trained in Railway Establishments are fully exempt from the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which is mandatory for all other Group D candidates.

Because these two benefits directly affect a candidate's final merit position and exam process, any CCAA candidate who has not yet recorded their NCVT marks needs to act within this window to remain eligible for them.

Why Was the CCAA Modification Window Opened?

This section explains the background that led RRB to open this window, helping candidates understand whether their specific situation matches the criteria.

The matter traces back to an earlier notice dated 3 February 2025, which addressed two categories of CCAA applicants:

  • Category 1: CCAAs who had already received their National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT at the time of application were instructed to enter their training duration, certificate details, and marks directly in the online form.
  • Category 2: CCAAs who had appeared for the NCVT examination before the application deadline, but whose results were not yet declared, were advised to fill in their exam date and flag the result as "awaited."

Despite this earlier instruction, a number of eligible CCAA candidates who went on to appear in the CBT still had not entered their NCVT marks in the system. To allow these candidates to claim the benefits they are entitled to under the CCAA quota, RRB has now opened this dedicated modification window from 17 to 23 June 2026.

Who Is Eligible for the RRB CCAA Modification Window 2026?

This section lists the exact eligibility conditions, since only candidates meeting all three criteria together can use this facility.

A candidate can use this modification window only if all three of the following conditions are met:

  1. The candidate appeared in the Computer Based Test (CBT) under CEN No. 08/2024.
  2. The candidate had not entered their NCVT examination marks in the original online application.
  3. The candidate had indicated the date of their NCVT examination in the application, typically with a "results awaited" flag.

If even one of these conditions is not met for instance, if you did not appear in the CBT, or if your NCVT marks were already filled in correctly at the time of application you are not eligible to use this window.

What Can Be Updated in the Modification Window?

This part covers exactly what information eligible candidates are permitted to add or change during the 17–23 June window.

During this window, eligible CCAA candidates can:

  • Fill in NCVT certificate details, if not entered earlier
  • Update the marks obtained in the NCVT examination
  • Enter National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) details

Once submitted, RRB uses this information to calculate the applicable NCVT weightage for the candidate's CCAA quota benefit, which then feeds into the preparation of the final merit list.

How to Update NCVT Details: Step-by-Step Process

This section walks through the practical process of making the update, from logging in to final submission.

  1. Visit the official RRB website for your respective zone, or the centralised application portal as indicated in your candidature.
  2. Log in to your CEN 08/2024 application using your registration number and password/date of birth.
  3. Navigate to the "Modification Window" or "CCAA/NCVT Details Update" section.
  4. Enter your NCVT certificate number, marks obtained, date of examination, training duration, and any other requested details.
  5. Upload supporting documents if the system prompts you to do so.
  6. Carefully review every entry before submission, since corrections cannot be made once the window closes.
  7. Submit the form before 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs, and save or download the confirmation/screenshot for your records.

Always complete this process only through the official RRB website for your zone or the application portal linked in the official notice. Avoid third-party websites claiming to offer "application update services," as these are not authorised by RRB.

What Happens If You Miss the Modification Window?

This section explains the consequences of not updating NCVT details within the given time frame, which is critical information for any eligible candidate still undecided about acting.

Missing this window has direct consequences for a CCAA candidate's selection prospects. If you do not update your certificate details and marks during the 17–23 June period, you will not be treated as a "CCAA Trained in Railway Establishment possessing NAC granted by NCVT." As a result, you will:

  • Lose the NCVT marks weightage benefit in the final merit list
  • Not be considered under the CCAA quota for this benefit
  • Likely be required to appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), which CCAA candidates would otherwise be exempt from

Given how competitive RRB Group D recruitment is, losing either of these advantages can materially affect your final selection chances. There is no indication of any extension beyond 23 June 2026, so candidates are advised not to wait until the last day.

Will NCVT Details Be Verified Later?

This short section addresses a common follow-up concern: whether the information submitted now will be checked later in the process.

Yes. As per the official notice, all NCVT examination details filled in by candidates during this modification window will be verified at the Document Verification (DV) stage. Candidature remains subject to the accuracy of the information submitted, so candidates should ensure that certificate numbers, marks, and dates exactly match their original NAC certificate and mark sheet before final submission.

Documents to Keep Ready

Having these documents on hand before you start the update process will make the modification quicker and reduce the risk of entry errors.

  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by NCVT
  • NCVT mark sheet showing marks obtained
  • Proof of apprenticeship training duration
  • Railway Establishment training-related documents

Event Date

Official Modification Notice Issued 16 June 2026
Modification Window Opens 17 June 2026, 00:01 hrs
Modification Window Closes 23 June 2026, 23:59 hrs

  • Assistant TL & AC

These are permanent central government jobs with pay under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 1, making this one of the most sought-after recruitment drives in India every year.

RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 - When Will It Be Released?

The official RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 is expected to be released in July 2026 on the Railway Recruitment Board's official website. The CBT 1 exam is tentatively scheduled in the 4th week of August 2026. The exact dates will be published in an official notification that will include the full exam schedule, city-wise centre allocation, and shift details.

Key points to note:

  • The exam date notice will be uploaded on rrbcdg.gov.in and all regional RRB websites.
  • The City Intimation Slip will be released at least 10 days before the exam date.
  • The Admit Card (Hall Ticket) will be available for download a few days before the CBT 1 date.
  • Candidates must log in with their Registration Number and Date of Birth to access these documents.

RRB Group D Exam Schedule 2026 - Tentative Shift Timings

The RRB Group D CBT 1 examination will be conducted in three shifts daily across multiple exam centres. Below are the tentative shift timings for the Railway Level 1 exam 2026. PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates who are using a scribe will get an additional 30 minutes per shift.

Shift Exam Start Time Duration (General) Duration (PwBD with Scribe)
Shift 1 9:00 AM 90 minutes 120 minutes
Shift 2 12:45 PM 90 minutes 120 minutes
Shift 3 5:00 PM 90 minutes 120 minutes

The exam will be held in over 200 examination centres spread across 21 railway zones, including major cities like Kolkata, Mumbai, Chennai, Patna, Hyderabad, and more.

Is RRB Group D Exam 2026 Postponed?

Many candidates are concerned about a possible postponement of the RRB Group D exam based on the previous experience with CEN 08/2024, where the exam was rescheduled multiple times due to court cases, normalization controversies, and administrative reasons.

However, candidates should note that such delays are not a regular occurrence with every recruitment cycle. Currently, there is no official notice or announcement about any postponement of the CEN 09/2025 CBT 1 examination. Candidates are advised to:

  • Continue their preparation without interruption.
  • Regularly check the official RRB website for any updates.
  • Avoid relying on unverified social media sources for exam date information.

Stay calm and focus on building a strong preparation strategy rather than worrying about possible delays.

RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

The City Intimation Slip is a pre-exam document that informs candidates about their allotted exam city and examination centre. This is different from the Admit Card and is released earlier to help candidates make travel and accommodation arrangements in advance.

Key facts about the RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026:

  • It will be released at least 10 days before the scheduled CBT 1 exam date.
  • Candidates can download it from the official regional RRB websites.
  • Login credentials required: Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  • The slip mentions the allotted exam city (not the exact centre address - that is on the admit card).

Candidates are strongly advised to download and check the city intimation slip as soon as it is released so they can plan their travel accordingly.

RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 - Hall Ticket Details

The RRB Group D Admit Card 2026 (Hall Ticket) for CEN 09/2025 CBT 1 will be released on the official RRB regional websites a few days before the exam. Candidates need to download and carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination hall.

The RRB Group D Hall Ticket 2026 will contain:

  • Candidate's name and photograph
  • Registration number and roll number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam centre name and address
  • Important exam day instructions

Important: Candidates must carry a valid government-issued photo ID proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, PAN Card, etc.) along with the admit card. Entry without a valid admit card will not be permitted.

RRB Group D Selection Process 2026

The RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 selection process involves three stages. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for final appointment:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT 1) - Online objective type exam of 90 minutes covering Mathematics, General Science, General Intelligence & Reasoning, and General Awareness.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - A qualifying round that tests the physical fitness of shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification & Medical Examination - Final stage where documents are verified and medical fitness is assessed as per Railway medical standards.

Merit lists are prepared based on CBT 1 scores, and PET is purely qualifying in nature.

RRB Group D Preparation Tips for CBT 1 2026

With the RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 approaching in August, candidates must now focus on revision, speed improvement, and managing exam-day stress. Here are proven preparation tips to maximize your score in CBT 1:

  • Revise core topics from Mathematics, General Science, Reasoning, and General Awareness daily. Focus especially on topics with high weightage in previous year papers.
  • Solve Mock Tests and Previous Year Question Papers regularly to improve time management and accuracy under exam conditions.
  • Avoid starting new topics at this late stage. Focus on strengthening weak areas within the syllabus you have already covered.
  • Prepare quick-revision notes with important formulas, science facts, current affairs, and GK points for the last-minute revision.
  • Follow a structured daily study plan that allocates time to each subject and includes regular breaks to avoid burnout.
  • Take care of your health - adequate sleep, a balanced diet, and regular light exercise will keep your mind sharp on exam day.
  • Check official RRB websites regularly for the latest announcements on exam dates, admit cards, and schedule changes.

HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 - Overview

HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 - Direct Download Link

The HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 will be made available on the official HPRCA portal as a downloadable PDF. Candidates must download the answer key PDF corresponding to their question paper set (Set A, B, C, or D) to ensure an accurate comparison with their responses. The answer key is the only official document that can be used to estimate your score and is critical for planning your next steps in the selection process. How to Download HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 - Step-by-Step Guide

Downloading the HP JBT Answer Key 2026 is a simple process through the HPRCA official portal. Follow the steps below carefully to ensure you access the correct answer key PDF without any confusion.

  • Step 1 - Visit the Official Website: Open hprca.hp.gov.in on your browser.
  • Step 2 - Locate the Answer Key Link: Navigate to the "Notifications" or "Answer Key" section on the homepage.
  • Step 3 - Select the Correct Link: Click on the link titled "HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 - Post Code 25004."
  • Step 4 - Open the PDF: The answer key PDF containing correct options for all questions will open on screen.
  • Step 5 - Save the Document: Download the file and, if needed, take a printout to compare manually with your question paper responses.

HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 - How to Calculate Your Score

Once candidates have the HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 in hand, they can easily estimate their total marks. Understanding the marking scheme is essential to get an accurate prediction of your result before the official declaration.

Exam Pattern at a Glance:

  • Total Questions: 200
  • Total Marks: 100
  • Marks per Question: 0.5
  • Negative Marking: No (as per general pattern)

Score Calculation Formula:

Total Score = Number of Correct Answers × 0.5

Steps to calculate your score:

  • Step 1: Open the HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026 PDF alongside your question paper or response sheet.
  • Step 2: Go through each question and mark which answers match the official key.
  • Step 3: Count the total number of correct responses.
  • Step 4: Multiply the number of correct answers by 0.5 to get your raw score out of 100.
  • Step 5: Compare your estimated score against the expected cut-off range to assess your chances of qualifying.

Since there is no negative marking, candidates need not deduct marks for incorrect or unattempted questions.

How to Raise Objections Against HP JBT Teacher Answer Key 2026

The HP JBT Answer Key 2026 objection window remains open for 7 days from the date of provisional key release. Candidates who believe a particular answer in the provisional key is incorrect can submit a formal challenge through the official candidate dashboard. The objection fee is ₹200 per question and must be paid online. Below is a clear step-by-step guide.

Step Action Required
Login Access the candidate dashboard using your application number and password
Select Question Choose the specific Question ID you wish to challenge
Upload Proof Attach a scanned copy of your reference material (standard textbooks, NCTE norms, etc.)
Pay Objection Fee Pay ₹200 per challenged question via the online payment gateway
Submit Review all details carefully and click Submit before the deadline

How to Calculate Your Score Using UP GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026

Once you have compared your responses with the provisional answer key, you can estimate your Prelims score using the formula below. This gives you a fair idea of whether you are likely to qualify for the Mains examination.

Score Calculation Formula:

Estimated Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 2.5) − (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.83)

Example Calculation:

Suppose a candidate attempted 100 out of 120 questions, with 82 correct and 18 wrong:

  • Marks from correct answers: 82 × 2.5 = 205 marks
  • Deduction for wrong answers: 18 × 0.83 = 14.94 marks
  • Estimated Total Score = 205 − 14.94 = 190.06 marks

Note: Unattempted questions carry zero marks and do not attract any negative marking.

UP GIC Lecturer Answer Key 2026: Objection Process

If a candidate believes any answer mentioned in the UPPSC GIC Lecturer provisional answer key is incorrect, they can file an objection through the official offline process. UPPSC does not accept online objections, email submissions, or objections sent through any medium other than post or hand delivery.

Important Rules for Filing Objections:

  • One separate objection form must be submitted for each disputed question
  • Objections must be supported by valid proof from recognized reference sources only NCERT/SCERT books, government-published textbooks, or standard academic references are accepted
  • Proof from Wikipedia, coaching institute materials, or private guidebooks will be automatically rejected

Step-by-Step Offline Objection Process

Step 1 - Download the Required Documents
Visit uppsc.up.nic.in and download the provisional answer key and the official objection representation form from the Notice Board section.

Step 2 - Fill the Objection Representation Form
Enter your name, roll number, exam name (UPPSC GIC Lecturer Exam 2025), your optional subject code and name, and your question booklet series (A, B, C, or D).

Step 3 - Prepare the Discrepancy Table
For each questioned answer, create a table with:

  • Serial number of objection
  • Question number as per your booklet
  • Answer given in the UPPSC provisional key
  • Answer you believe is correct
  • Reference source with book name, author, edition, and exact page number

Step 4 - Attach Self-Attested Photocopies
Attach photocopies of the relevant pages from your reference book or government publication. Each copy must be self-attested.

Step 5 - Send by Post or Hand Delivery
Place all documents in a sealed envelope and send it via Speed Post, Registered Post, or hand delivery to:

The Exam Controller
Atigopan-5 Section
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)
10 Kasturba Gandhi Marg
Prayagraj - 211018

Objection Window: The objection deadline will be notified officially by UPPSC. Candidates are advised to keep checking uppsc.up.nic.in regularly.

UPPSC GIC Lecturer 2025: Selection Process

Candidates who qualify the Preliminary Examination will be called for the subsequent stages of selection. The complete selection process consists of:

  1. Written Preliminary Examination (Objective MCQ - 300 marks)
  2. Main (Written) Examination
  3. Interview
  4. Document Verification
  5. Final Merit List Preparation

The Prelims is a screening test. Marks obtained in the Preliminary Examination are not counted towards the final merit list. Only candidates who clear the Prelims cutoff are eligible for the Mains examination.

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. What Is the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026?

This section explains what the answer key is and why it matters for candidates who took the Graduate Level exam.

The UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026 is the provisional set of correct answers released by the commission for the recruitment examination held on June 14, 2026. The exam was conducted for various graduate-level posts under Advertisement No. 70/U030/2025 and was held in a single shift from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM. After the exam concluded, UKSSSC prepared and published the answer key for all four sets of the question paper Set A, Set B, Set C, and Set D allowing candidates to verify the correctness of their responses before final results are declared.

Since the answer key is provisional, it is not the final word on correct answers. UKSSSC has clearly stated that the key may be revised based on objections raised by candidates, which is why the objection window exists before the final answer key and result are prepared.

How to Raise an Objection Against the UKSSSC Graduate Level Answer Key 2026

This section outlines the guidelines candidates must follow while submitting an objection, as instructed by the commission.

UKSSSC has laid out clear instructions for the objection process to maintain transparency and ensure only valid claims are reviewed. Candidates raising an objection must:

  • Submit objections only through the official online portal no other mode is accepted.
  • Attach valid supporting documents or evidence to justify each objection raised.
  • Pay the required ₹50 fee for every question being objected to.
  • Submit all objections within the prescribed deadline, i.e., by 5:00 PM on June 21, 2026.

Once the objection window closes, UKSSSC will examine all the valid objections received and accordingly prepare and publish the final answer key.

What Happens After the Objection Period Ends?

After June 21, 2026, UKSSSC will review every objection submitted by candidates along with the supporting evidence provided. Based on this review, the commission will finalize the answer key, making corrections wherever an objection is found valid. The final answer key forms the basis on which the Graduate Level exam results will eventually be calculated and declared.

  3. Noting the number of correct and incorrect answers based on the answer key.
  4. Keeping track of any answers they wish to formally object to, along with proof, before the objection window closes.

Rajasthan PTET 2026 Marking Scheme and Exam Pattern

Before calculating an expected score, candidates need to understand exactly how marks are awarded across the four sections of the PTET paper. This section breaks down the question distribution, maximum marks, and the special scaled-marking rule that applies only to the Teaching Aptitude section.

The PTET 2026 exam consisted of 200 objective-type questions worth a combined 600 marks, divided equally across four sections of 50 questions each.

Section Topic Questions Maximum Marks
Section A Mental Ability 50 150
Section B Teaching Attitude & Aptitude 50 150
Section C General Awareness 50 150
Section D Language Proficiency (Hindi or English) 50 150
Total   200 600

For Sections A, C, and D, the marking is straightforward:

Answer Type Marks Awarded
Correct Answer +3
Wrong Answer 0 (no negative marking)
Unattempted 0

Section B (Teaching Attitude & Aptitude) uses a scaled marking approach instead of a simple right-or-wrong system, since some questions in this section can have more than one reasonably correct option:

Response Quality Marks Awarded
Most Appropriate Answer +3
Second Best Answer +2
Marginally Correct Answer +1
Completely Incorrect Answer 0

There is no negative marking anywhere in the PTET exam, so candidates lose nothing for an incorrect or skipped response.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the PTET Answer Key 2026

This section explains the simple formula candidates can use to estimate their probable PTET score once they've matched their responses against the answer key. Since there's no negative marking, the calculation mainly involves counting correct answers and multiplying by the marks-per-question value.

  1. Download the answer key PDF matching your booklet Set (A, B, C, or D).
  2. Go through your OMR response sheet or recall the options you marked for each question.
  3. Tally the total number of questions you answered correctly in Sections A, C, and D.
  4. For Section B, apply the scaled marking values (+3, +2, +1, or 0) based on how closely your chosen option matches the "most appropriate" answer.
  5. Add up the marks from all four sections to arrive at your estimated total score.

Formula for Sections A, C, and D: Estimated Score = Number of Correct Answers × 3

Correct Answers Marks per Question Estimated Score
120 3 360
150 3 450
180 3 540

Keep in mind that this is only a provisional estimate. Your final, official score will depend on the final answer key issued after all valid objections have been reviewed and incorporated.

How to Raise an Objection Against the PTET Answer Key 2026

This section details the complete process for challenging an answer in the provisional key, including the eligibility criteria, required documents, and the fee structure. Only candidates who actually appeared for the exam are permitted to file an objection.

If you believe any answer in the provisional key is incorrect, you can challenge it online during the objection window, which typically stays open for 3 to 4 days after the provisional key's release. Each objection must be backed by credible evidence from a recognised academic textbook personal notes, coaching material, or unverified online sources are not accepted as valid proof.

  1. Log in to the official VMOU PTET candidate portal using your application number and password.
  2. Open the "Question Objection" or "Objection Form" section for your course (2-Year or 4-Year B.Ed.).
  3. Select your booklet Set code and enter the exact question number you wish to challenge.
  4. Write a clear justification explaining why you believe the listed answer is wrong, and state the option you think is correct.
  5. Upload a scanned page from a standard textbook supporting your claim, along with the book's name, author, and edition.
  6. Pay the objection fee of ₹100 per question through net banking, debit card, or credit card.
  7. Submit the form and download the payment confirmation receipt for your records.

After the objection window closes, a subject-expert committee constituted by VMOU reviews every challenge. Objections found valid are incorporated into the final answer key, which then forms the basis for the official result.

What does the Asterisk (*) mean in the RPSC answer key?

Several questions across subjects carry an asterisk (*) mark in the RPSC Senior Teacher Final Answer Key 2026. This is an important notation that every candidate should understand before calculating their expected score.

An asterisk (*) in the RPSC answer key means that the particular question has been officially deleted by the Rajasthan Public Service Commission. All candidates who appeared for that paper will receive full marks for the deleted question, regardless of whether they attempted it or which option they chose. This is a standard practice followed by RPSC whenever a question is found to be ambiguous, incorrect, out of syllabus, or disputed during the answer key challenge process.

How to Calculate Your Expected Score Using the RPSC Answer Key

Once you have downloaded the subject-wise final answer key, you can estimate your score by following the scoring pattern used by RPSC for the Senior Teacher competitive examination.

  • Correct Answer: Check your response against the final answer key. If it matches, note it as correct.
  • Marks for Correct Answer: Each correct answer carries positive marks as per the exam's official marking scheme.
  • Deleted Questions: Add full marks for every question marked with (*) in your subject paper, as all candidates receive credit for deleted questions.
  • Negative Marking: RPSC typically applies negative marking for wrong answers. Refer to the official notification for the exact negative marking ratio applicable for this exam.
  • Final Score: Tally your correct answers and subtract deductions for wrong ones to get your estimated total score.

SSC Delhi Police HC (AWO/TPO) Marking Scheme 2026: How to Calculate Your Score

This section breaks down the exact scoring formula used in the Computer-Based Examination, allowing candidates to estimate their tentative marks using the final answer key.

The Delhi Police HC (AWO/TPO) exam follows a standard SSC marking scheme with negative marking for incorrect attempts:

  • +1 mark is awarded for every correct answer.
  • −0.25 marks are deducted for every incorrect attempt.
  • 0 marks are given for questions left unattempted.

The formula to calculate your final score is:

Final Marks = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) − (Number of Incorrect Attempts × 0.25)

For example, if a candidate attempted 85 questions out of which 12 were incorrect, the calculation would be:

Final Marks = (73 × 1) − (12 × 0.25) = 73 − 3 = 70 marks

What Is the JKSSB Provisional Answer Key 2026?

The provisional answer key is a temporary official document released by JKSSB after the completion of the written examination. Understanding what it is and how to use it helps candidates make the most of the limited objection window.

The JKSSB Provisional Answer Key lists the correct answers to all questions asked in the Prosthetic/Orthotic Technician written examination. It is released in provisional form - meaning it is subject to revision based on valid objections raised by candidates. Once the objection window closes and JKSSB reviews all challenges, a Final Answer Key is published, which is then used to calculate scores and prepare the official merit list and result.

The key purposes of the provisional answer key are:

  • To ensure transparency in the recruitment process
  • To help candidates estimate their probable marks before the result
  • To give candidates a fair opportunity to challenge incorrect answers with supporting evidence
  • To maintain the integrity of the selection process

How to Download JKSSB Prosthetic/Orthotic Technician Answer Key 2026 PDF

Candidates can download the provisional answer key in a few simple steps from the official JKSSB portal. Here is the step-by-step process to access the PDF directly.

  1. Visit the official JKSSB website: jkssb.nic.in
  2. Navigate to the "Answer Keys" or "What's New" section on the homepage
  3. Look for the link titled "Provisional Answer Key - Prosthetic/Orthotic Technician"
  4. Click on the link to open or download the PDF
  5. Save the PDF to your device for future reference

Direct PDF Link: JKSSB Prosthetic/Orthotic Technician Provisional Answer Key 2026 - Download PDF

How to Calculate Your Score Using the JKSSB Answer Key 2026

Once you have the provisional answer key in hand, you can use it to estimate your total marks. Here is how to calculate your expected score using JKSSB's standard marking scheme.

JKSSB typically follows a negative marking scheme in its OMR-based written examinations. Use the formula below to calculate your approximate score:

Score Calculation Formula:

Total Score = (Number of Correct Answers × Marks per Question) − (Number of Wrong Answers × Negative Marking)

Answer Type Marks
Correct Answer +1 Mark (standard)
Wrong Answer −¼ Mark (negative marking)
Unattempted Question 0 Marks

Scoring Tips:

  • Count only the answers you are certain are correct for a realistic estimate
  • Do not guess wildly - the negative marking can reduce your total score significantly
  • Use this estimated score to assess whether you need to raise objections on specific questions

How to Raise Objections Against JKSSB Prosthetic/Orthotic Technician Answer Key 2026

If a candidate finds any discrepancy or error in the provisional answer key, JKSSB provides an opportunity to formally challenge it. All objections must be submitted in offline mode within the stipulated deadline.

Step-by-Step Objection Process

  1. Download the provisional answer key PDF from jkssb.nic.in
  2. Identify the question(s) you wish to challenge, noting the question number and series
  3. Fill in the prescribed objection format (as provided in the official JKSSB notification/annexure)
  4. Attach supporting evidence - textbook references, official publications, or other valid documentary proof justifying your objection
  5. Prepare a Demand Draft (DD) of ₹200 per question in favour of the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board (this fee is refundable if your objection is found valid)
  6. Submit your objection in person or by post at the designated JKSSB office within the allowed working days:
    • Jammu Office: Muthi, Akhnoor Road, Jammu
    • Srinagar Office: Zamzam Building, Rambagh, Srinagar

Important Rules for Raising Objections

  • Objections must be submitted within the stipulated working days from the date of answer key release
  • Only offline submissions are accepted - email or online challenges will not be entertained
  • Objections submitted after the deadline will be summarily rejected regardless of merit
  • The objection fee must be submitted along with the representation - incomplete submissions will not be considered
  • The Board's decision on objections will be final; the Final Answer Key released after reviewing all objections will be used for result preparation

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes?

After the objection deadline passes, JKSSB reviews all valid representations received from candidates. Here is what candidates can expect next in the recruitment timeline.

Once all objections are reviewed by subject experts:

  • JKSSB releases the Final Answer Key, incorporating any corrections made on the basis of valid challenges
  • Candidates' scores are calculated using the Final Answer Key only
  • The Merit List and Result are prepared based on final scores
  • Shortlisted candidates may then be called for document verification or further stages of selection as per the recruitment rules

Candidates are advised to keep checking the official JKSSB website regularly for updates on the final answer key, result declaration date, and merit list.

You will be the person our clients rely on to actually get them interviews. When a client is a VP of Engineering targeting a Head of Product role at a Series B, you need to know that the right person to reach out to is the CTO or a senior technical recruiter, not an HR coordinator. That kind of judgment is what this role runs on. Key responsibilities: 1. Manage and monitor client LinkedIn profiles, including activity, messaging, and profile presentation. 7. Conduct regular LinkedIn audits and share structured feedback and improvement recommendations. 8. Generate weekly or bi-weekly client reports covering outreach sent, opens, replies, interviews scheduled, and pipeline status. 9. Track each client’s application pipeline from saved to applied to interviewing and keep records updated. 10. Communicate proactively with clients when attention or input is required. 11. Flag patterns, blockers, or client issues to internal leads before they become problems. Strong understanding of the job search process and practical hiring workflows. 3. Strong written English skills for writing client-facing emails and reports. 4. Comfortable working with LinkedIn, spreadsheets, email clients, and new SaaS tools. 5. High ownership mindset with the ability to manage deliverables independently. 6. Ability to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously without missing deadlines. 7. Good understanding of corporate hierarchy and stakeholder targeting. 8. Previous startup experience is a strong plus. 9. Familiarity with ATS systems, cold email tools, or LinkedIn outreach is a strong plus. What good looks like at 90 days: 1. Managing a full client portfolio independently with minimal escalations. 2. Ensuring client reports and outreach activities are delivered consistently on time. 3. Proactively flagging edge cases and judgment calls instead of making assumptions or remaining silent. 4. Helping clients receive replies and schedule interviews successfully.

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and
SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across
150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value,
demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations,
automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity
and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events
daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names
supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first
organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space
for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here,
innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million
conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real
people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre
proud to be a part of that.

Role Summary

As the Staff Product Manager for Product Information Management, you will own the end-to-end
vision, strategy, and execution of HighLevelâs PIM â the foundational catalog layer that powers all
commerce activity across the platform. Your mission is to lead a structural overhaul of our existing
catalog infrastructure and build a world-class PIM that handles physical products, digital goods, and
services at scale. This is not just the backbone of our Commerce charter; it is shared infrastructure
consumed by multiple adjacent product teams, and the decisions you make here will have platform-
wide impact.

â Own the PIM Vision: Define and drive the end-to-end roadmap for HighLevelâs Product
Information Management system â from Items, Variants, and Catalog Items to Price Lists,
Units of Measure, and multi-channel price resolution logic
â Lead the Catalog Overhaul: Architect the migration from our existing catalog foundation to a
robust, extensible PIM that supports the full breadth of HighLevelâs commerce use cases
across product types and selling channels
â Design for Multi-Team Consumption: Define clear API contracts and data models that
serve not just the Commerce team, but adjacent teams building service-based and
subscription-based product experiences â ensuring every consumer can reliably depend on
PIM as a platform
â Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Lead structured collaboration with engineering, design,
and partner product teams to ensure PIM capabilities meet requirements across all consuming
surfaces, resolving conflicting priorities with clarity and conviction
â Shape Pricing Infrastructure: Own the strategy for multi-currency, rule-based, and channel-
aware pricing â ensuring the right price resolves correctly at every point of sale across all

â Champion the Merchant Experience: Translate complex catalog management requirements
into intuitive workflows that allow merchants across industries â from physical goods retailers
to service providers â to create, organize, and manage their offerings with ease
â Set the Platform Standard: Establish foundational patterns and best practices that make the

â Influence the Broader Commerce Roadmap: Partner with peer PMs across the Commerce

â Bias for Ownership: Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments with the

About the Role

The People Operations at Nabis owns outcomes, not just tasks. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of Recruiting, Training & Engagement, and cross-functional People projects. Youâll partner with department leaders across the company, build and maintain training programs, and drive People initiatives from scoping through execution.

The ideal candidate brings strong organizational instincts, clear communication, and a genuine passion for talent development and operational process. You know how to hold multiple priorities at once without losing the thread on any of them. You drive results through accountability and you use data to make decisions and tell the story of whatâs working.

If your instinct when you see a broken process is to document it and wait for approval, this isnât your seat. If itâs to fix it, loop in the right people, and build a system so it doesnât break again, keep reading.

What Youâll Own

Training and employee development. You make sure our people have what they need to do their jobs well and grow. That means monitoring mandatory training completion in the LMS, building new development content as needs arise, and continuously improving new hire orientation for both on-site and remote employees. You partner with the Operations team on role-specific training, support interview and manager skill-building, and align training programs with performance reviews and succession planning.

Employee engagement and culture. You drive engagement through existing programs and develop new gamification initiatives designed to improve bi-annual employee engagement scores. You think creatively about how to keep a distributed, multi-site workforce connected and motivated.

Cross-functional People projects. You own project scope, assign tasks in Asana, and drive outcomes for initiatives across the People team, from updating the employee referral program to DEI initiatives, to new hire orientation decks, to manager interview training. You communicate progress and new initiatives company-wide via Slack and email, and you bring others along.

Onboarding infrastructure. You own standardizing the onboarding experience company-wide ensuring every new team member, hourly and salaried, on-site and remote, has a consistent, high-quality start.

Offboarding. You ensure departing employees have a consistent, respectful exit experience. That includes coordinating system access removal, collecting company assets, and conducting exit interviews to surface themes that inform retention and engagement strategy.

What the First 90 Days Look Like

  • Month 1: Learn the landscape. Embedded with the People team. Getting fluent in our LMS, ATS, and internal tools. You leave this stretch knowing where the gaps are and what needs to move first.
  • Month 2: Build momentum. New hire onboarding boards are audited and current. You have a clear point of view on the training gaps and youâve started closing the most urgent ones.
  • Month 3: Execute and improve. Youâre driving People projects with real ownership. They are scoped, tracked in Asana, and on time. Engagement initiatives are in motion. Youâre showing up as a trusted partner to the department leads you work with, and youâre already identifying what comes next.

What Weâre Looking For

  • 5+ years in People Operations, HR, or Recruiting, ideally inside a fast-moving company supporting both hourly and salaried workforces. You understand that what works for one population doesnât automatically work for the other.
  • Comfort with HR systems. You can navigate an ATS and LMS without hand-holding. You know how to pull a report, build a workflow, and spot where the data is off.
  • Strong project management instincts. You break big initiatives into tasks, assign ownership, and follow through. You run multiple tracks at once without losing the thread on any of them.
  • Clear, direct communication. Whether youâre writing a company-wide Slack post, a new-hire deck, or a note to a hiring manager; your writing is crisp, your follow-through is reliable, and people know what to expect from you.
  • Genuine passion for people and process. You care about candidate experience, employee development, and operational excellence not as buzzwords, but as the actual work.
  • Data-driven. You track what matters, report on it regularly, and use it to make decisions and advocate for resources.

What This Role Is Not

  • A coordinator role where someone else defines the work and you execute tasks.
  • A reactive HR support role without meaningful ownership of recruiting outcomes, training programs, or People projects.

About Mission Inbox

We are a B2B email infrastructure platform built for businesses that treat deliverability as a competitive advantage. More than 80 million emails leave our servers every month, and that number keeps climbing.

We are early-stage but cash-flow positive and profitable. That means you get the energy and ownership of a startup without the survival anxiety that usually comes with it. Every hire moves the needle directly. There is nowhere to hide, and that is the point.

Read This Part Carefully

This is not an easy job, and we are not going to pretend otherwise.

Customer Success is the backbone of Mission Inbox. CS is not a side function that answers tickets and forwards bugs. It is the connective tissue between our customers, our product, and our roadmap. When a customer succeeds or churns, it runs through this team first. That comes with real weight.

If you want a quiet, narrowly-scoped support role, this is the wrong listing. If you want to break into the startup world from the single best seat in the building, where you touch support, product, quality, and documentation in the same week, keep reading.

What You Will Actually Do

This role spans four areas. You will rotate through and eventually own pieces of all of them.2. Platform QA3. Product Direction4. Knowledge Base Creation

  • Customer Support
  • Be the first human a customer talks to when something is unclear, broken, or on fire
  • Resolve deliverability, configuration, and platform questions with speed and accuracy
  • Manage conversations in Intercom and turn one-off questions into reusable answers
  • Use the product the way customers do, then break it on purpose
  • Catch bugs, edge cases, and confusing flows before customers hit them
  • File clear, reproducible reports that engineering can act on without a back-and-forth
  • Sit closest to the customer, which makes you a primary input to the roadmap
  • Surface patterns from support conversations: what confuses people, what they ask for, what they almost churned over
  • Translate raw customer signal into product feedback the team can prioritize
  • Build and maintain the documentation, guides, and help content that scale our answers
  • Turn every recurring question into an article so the next customer self-serves
  • Treat the knowledge base as a product, not an afterthought

Who This Is For

You will thrive here if you

  • Are early in your career and hungry to learn fast
  • Like ownership and discomfort over comfort
  • Write clearly and think in systems
  • Are curious about how software actually works
  • Want startup experience at a company that is already profitable

The Growth Ceiling

We are not offering you an entry-level box to sit in. We are offering a launchpad.

CS is where you learn the entire business: the product, the customer, the economics, and how decisions actually get made. People who master this seat go on to run things.

For proof, look up the chain. Our own CEO started his career as a Customer Success rep and went on to build and exit companies. The seat you are applying for is the same one that taught him how a business actually works. We are not promising you the same outcome. We are telling you the ceiling is high and the path is real.

Requirements

What We Look For

Required

  • Strong written communication. You will live in writing
  • Genuine curiosity and a bias toward figuring things out yourself
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a willingness to own outcomes, not just tasks
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have

  • Exposure to SaaS, email, marketing, or technical products
  • Any experience that proves you can teach yourself a complex tool
  • Spanish/Portuguese is a plus given our distributed team

No specific degree or years of experience required. We index on judgment, drive, and clarity of thought over credentials.

Benefits

How We Work

  • Fully remote and globally distributed. We hire for talent, not timezone
  • High leverage, high trust. You get real responsibility early
  • Profitable and stable. Startup pace, without the funding-cliff fear

This role supports case processing activities and safety operations to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) intake, processing, reporting, and reconciliation in accordance with global regulatory requirements and company procedures.

Major Duties / Responsibilities

  • Process adverse events (AE) and special situation cases (intake, triage, data entry, follow-up, narrative writing, coding, and quality review) in the safety database in accordance with SOPs and applicable regulations.

  • Reconcile safety data with clinical, medical information, product quality, and/or partner sources; investigate discrepancies and support periodic reconciliation deliverables.
  • Participate in operational metrics tracking (throughput, timeliness, quality), identifying root causes of trends and proposing process improvements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Quality, Regulatory, and vendors/partners to obtain follow-up information, query resolutions and ensure consistent safety data.
  • Support inspections/audits by ensuring accurate documentation and responding to requests under supervision.
  • Contribute to the maintenance and continuous improvement of pharmacovigilance processes, templates, and work instructions.
  • Support cross-functional safety data review meeting activities including but not limited to distribution of meeting materials and completing meeting minutes.

Key Competencies

  • Ownership, accountability, and reliability in meeting timelines

  • Experience in safety databases, including end-to-end case workflow (intake through submission/distribution), case follow-up, and data quality activities.
  • Working knowledge of global PV regulations and guidelines (e.g., ICH E2A/E2B(R3)/E2D; FDA/EMA reporting concepts) and pharmacovigilance SOPs.
  • Experience with medical coding conventions and safety data quality practices.
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to follow procedures, and commitment to data integrity and compliance.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills; ability to summarize case information clearly in narratives.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet timelines in a high-volume environment.
  • Bachelorâs degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, public health, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Preferred Education And Experience

  • Experience with safety data reconciliation (clinical vs. safety), partner data exchange, and/or case distribution workflows.
  • Familiarity with safety reporting gateways and E2B(R3) transmission concepts.
  • Experience supporting periodic reporting activities (e.g., DSUR/PSUR/PBRER support tasks) or signal detection support tasks.
  • Prior experience working with vendors/CROs and case processing metrics/KPIs.
  • Experience in a GxP environment with exposure to audits/inspections.

Other Duties

Work Environment

This position may require working across time zones to support global case processing timelines. The role involves routine computer-based work and sustained attention to detail while processing confidential safety information.

Travel

Physical Demands

This is a remote position with employees working from a home office. The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the primary functions of this position. The physical demands of the home office are normally associated with extended amounts of time sitting and using office equipment (including a computer, keyboard, and mouse), standing, walking, sitting, speaking, and hearing. The employee must occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds.

Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $70,000 - $85,000 per year. Higher compensation may be available for someone with advanced skills and/or experience.

At Puma Biotechnology, we offer an attractive compensation package to our team members. Reporting to the Associate Director, Project Management, this role will serve as a key partner in driving execution across strategic initiatives spanning product development, manufacturing, and commercialization within our blended nutrition portfolio.

The Project Manager will lead cross-functional coordination and play a critical role in ensuring program success in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment by managing timelines and dependencies, facilitating stakeholder alignment, and ensuring critical milestones are achieved. The ideal candidate is highly organized and proactive, brings strong experience in consumer-packaged goods, and has demonstrated success operating in complex programs that require both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.   • Identify opportunities to improve coordination, streamline execution, and enhance collaboration across highly interdependent workstreams.
  • Prepare executive-ready project updates, recommendations, and reporting materials for leadership stakeholders

Role Snapshot
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

THE ROLE

At Grove Collaborative, every product on our site represents a choice someone made to live a little more sustainably. Keeping those products in stock â at the right time, in the right place, in the right quantity â is where you come in.

We're looking for an Inventory Planner who brings genuine enthusiasm for AI-powered planning tools and the analytical depth to use them well. This isn't a role for someone who treats automation as a supplement to how they already work â we're looking for someone who leads with it, actively pilots new technologies, and brings the judgment to know when to trust the model and when to push back on it.

You'll own replenishment planning across a high-SKU, DTC assortment, managing inventory across two fulfillment centers in a fast-moving eCommerce environment. If you've carried this kind of complexity before â large SKU counts, multiple vendors, high velocity â and have used modern planning platforms and AI tooling to manage it at scale rather than through sheer effort, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOUâLL OWN

  • Demand-Driven Replenishment â Evaluate sales forecasts and execute inventory purchases that support sales optimization, turn expectations, and in-stock goals across a high-SKU assortment. Leverage AI-powered demand forecasting platforms to translate signals into actionable replenishment decisions â and bring the judgment to know when manual intervention improves on the model.
  • Planning Systems Ownership â Own and maintain supplier configurations and replenishment parameters within planning and ERP systems across your assigned vendor base. Investigate forecast exceptions and drive accuracy and bias improvement through data-informed adjustments.
  • Inventory Performance & Analytics â Monitor key inventory KPIs and drive corrective action. Build and maintain reporting in Looker, Excel, and AI-driven analytics tools that goes beyond describing what happened to recommending what to do next.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership â Partner with Merchandising and Marketing to develop strategies that move aged inventory. Work closely with suppliers to ensure follow-through on replenishment orders and forecasted commitments. Liaise with Billing and Accounting on invoicing and receipt discrepancies.
  • Order Management â Track orders from PO submission through EDI confirmation and receipt into fulfillment centers. Recommend stock balance transfers between warehouse locations based on demand signals and fulfillment data.
  • Continuous Improvement â Champion ongoing improvement in planning systems, data quality, and processes. Proactively identify and pilot AI and automation opportunities â anomaly detection, automated reorder triggers, scenario modeling â and share what works with the broader team.

ABOUT YOU

  • 4â6 years of inventory planning and procurement experience in a DTC or digitally native eCommerce environment, with demonstrated success managing a high-SKU, high-velocity assortment
  • Hands-on experience with demand forecasting platforms such as Relex, Toolio, Anaplan, or equivalent â including genuine curiosity about evaluating and adopting new planning technologies as they emerge
  • Demonstrated AI fluency applied specifically to inventory planning workflows â demand sensing, automated replenishment, anomaly detection, or scenario modeling â and an active appetite to push further as the tools evolve
  • Advanced Excel proficiency required; Looker or equivalent BI tool experience strongly preferred
  • Proven track record against core inventory metrics: in-stock rate, turn, weeks of supply, forecast accuracy, and aged inventory reduction
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills â able to translate planning data into clear, actionable recommendations for Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, and Operations partners
  • A self-directed working style; you seek out the best available tools, move without being asked, and treat continuous improvement as a core part of the job â not an extra

EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience managing inventory across multiple warehouse or fulfillment center locations
  • Familiarity with EDI workflows and ERP systems in a physical products environment
  • Exposure to AI-assisted scenario planning or automated exception management at scale
  • A genuine connection to sustainability and the better-for-you product space â you understand why customers choose Grove and that perspective informs how you think about the work

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts.
  • Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental
  • Equity - shared success is core to our mission
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - we care most about results
  • Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount
  • Working for a company that believes that a small group of people can change the world for the better by creating products and funding initiatives that help the planet!

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $75,000-90,000. Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country. In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for an annual incentive target and equity.

MORE ABOUT GROVE

Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Explore thousands of thoughtfully vetted products for every room and everyone in your home, including household cleaning, personal care, health and wellness, laundry, clean beauty, kitchen, pantry, kids, baby, pet care, and beyond. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard â from health to sustainability and performance â so you get a great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, Grove goes beyond selling products: every order is carbon neutral, supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives, and lets you see and track the positive impact of your choices. Shopping with purpose starts at Grove.com.

Location: UK, Spain or Portugal

Role: Director of Commercial Operations

Reporting to: CEO, Curaleaf International

POSITION SUMMARY:

Curaleaf International is one of Europe's largest vertically integrated medical cannabis businesses, operating across the UK, Germany, Poland and Australia with EU GMP-certified production facilities in Portugal, Spain and Canada. Revenue is growing rapidly and we are building the commercial infrastructure to match.

This is a newly created role at the heart of our commercial operations. The Director of Commercial Operations is responsible for building the demand-led commercial infrastructure the business needs to scale: the demand planning function, the sales governance framework and the commercial processes that connect market intelligence to supply decisions. Working alongside our market Managing Directors, this person instils the discipline and rigour that turns commercial ambition into an executable plan.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial governance and sales process

  • Create a long term pipeline visibility: creating the tools, templates and disciplines so the business has a consolidated forward view of commercial performance at all times
  • Establish the commercial review cadence: weekly market reviews where country heads present pipeline, wins/losses and pricing issues against a consistent framework
  • Define what good looks like for each market in terms of pipeline visibility and forecast accuracy, then build the process to get there

Own the commercial demand signal

  • Own the forward-looking commercial demand plan: a SKU-level, market-by-market view of what the business needs to sell and when, grounded in real market intelligence rather than historical patterns or available inventory
  • Ensure the demand signal is locked and signed off at the start of each planning cycle = supply teams plan against this number, not a moving target
  • Partner with the Group Demand & S&OP Manager to ensure the commercial demand signal feeds cleanly into the S&OP process
  • Partner with Finance for monthly re-forecast process; changes to the demand signal are governed and visible, not ad hoc
  • Perform SKU level market by market demand signal for smaller business entities
  • Perform long term portfolio planning working with the US based team for insights into how the markets may evolve in the future, regulatory team for insights into potential industry changes and create a forward looking consolidated plan to hand over to R&D and genetics team for future launches
  • Create mid-high level long term demand plans incorporating market analysis portfolio planning for handover to the GM's on a bi-annual basis, allowing them to translate this into a SKU level forecast
  • Ensure the demand signal is locked and signed off at the start of each planning cycle = supply teams plan against this number, not a moving target
  • Partner with the Group Demand & S&OP Manager to ensure the commercial demand signal feeds cleanly into the S&OP process
  • Partner with Finance for monthly re-forecast process; changes to the demand signal are governed and visible, not ad hoc

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Experience

  • 10+ years in commercial operations, merchandising, demand planning or commercial excellence with a track record of building these functions, not just operating within them
  • Background in FMCG direct experience with prescription, pharmacy or clinical channels strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to design and implement sales governance frameworks and demand planning processes in a multi-market environment where no unified process previously existed
  • Strong analytical capability: comfortable building SKU-level demand models, margin analyses and commercial dashboards independently
  • Experience working alongside geo-based commercial teams in a matrix structure, influencing without direct line authority

Preferred

  • Familiarity with multi-country demand planning across markets with structurally different commercial models
  • Experience working with or alongside an S&OP function with clear understanding of where commercial demand planning ends and S&OP mechanics begin

You

  • A playing coach: you design the framework and you do the work; you do not hand over a slide deck and move on
  • A builder: you are energised by creating processes and governance that did not exist before and that outlast any individual decision
  • Direct and constructive: you can tell a commercial team their forecast is not credible and show them why, without damaging the relationship
  • Committed to the Curaleaf values: Lead & Inspire, Commit to Win, Customer Obsession, One Curaleaf, Driven to Deliver Excellence

This position has no specific physical requirements.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

This position has no specific environmental conditions.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a genuine commercial transformation at a fast-scaling international medical cannabis business with direct CEO and CFO exposure, real cross-market impact from day one, and the mandate to build something the business will rely on for years.

Curaleaf International is shaping the future of cannabis through its commitment to research and product excellence. Powered by a strong presence at all stages of the supply chain, its unique distribution network throughout Europe, Canada and Australasia brings together pioneering research with cutting-edge cultivation, extraction, and production.
